#Data used for MR analysis 
eGFR GWAS CKDGen data  Stanzick et al. 2021 
  https://ckdgen.imbi.uni-freiburg.de/datasets/Stanzick_2021
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34272381/

PQTL decode summary statistics  Ferkingstad et al. 2021
  Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, et al. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet. 2021; 53(12):1712-1721. doi:10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
  Summary data | deCODE genetics 
  optional : the pqt of INTERVAL study could also be used. 

https://andrewslabucsf.github.io/MR-tutorial/scripts/mr.html 

## Local configuration

Run this setup chunk before the analysis sections. The data, results workbook,
and OpenGWAS credential must be supplied locally; see `README.md`.

```{r local-configuration, include=FALSE}
# Start from the repository directory, or set MR_PROJECT_DIR externally.
mr_project_dir <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("MR_PROJECT_DIR", unset = getwd()),
  winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE
)
mr_data_dir <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("MR_DATA_DIR", unset = file.path(mr_project_dir, "data")),
  winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
)
mr_results_dir <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("MR_RESULTS_DIR", unset = file.path(mr_project_dir, "results")),
  winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
)
mr_workbook <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("MR_RESULTS_WORKBOOK", unset = file.path(mr_data_dir, "MR_Results.xlsx")),
  winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
)
mr_forest_dir <- file.path(mr_results_dir, "forest_plots")
dir.create(mr_results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(mr_forest_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Keep relative analysis outputs and cached objects in the ignored results folder.
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = mr_results_dir)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
setwd(mr_results_dir)

configure_opengwas <- function() {
  jwt <- Sys.getenv("OPENGWAS_JWT", unset = "")
  if (!nzchar(trimws(jwt))) {
    stop("Set OPENGWAS_JWT in your local environment before LD clumping.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  # Retain compatibility with the original code's option-based configuration.
  options(ieugwasr_token = jwt)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# 1. Candidate genes from your mass-spec analysis
```{r}
set.seed(1234)
candidate_proteins <- tribble(
  ~protein_full_name, ~overlap, ~uniprot_id, ~Gene,
  "Complement factor D", "CFAD", "K7ERG9", "CFD",
  "Retinol-binding protein 4", "RBP4", "Q5VY30", "RBP4",
  "Pigment epithelium-derived factor", "PEDF", "P36955", "SERPINF1",
  "Beta-2-microglobulin", "B2M", "P61769", "B2M",
  "Zinc-alpha-2-glycoprotein", "ZA2G", "P25311", "AZGP1",
  "Prostaglandin-H2 D-isomerase", "PTGDS", "P41222", "PTGDS",
  "Glutathione peroxidase 3", "GPX3", "P22352", "GPX3",
  "Rhox homeobox family member 1", "RHXF1", "Q8NHV9", "RHOXF1",
  "Transferrin receptor protein 1", "TFR1", "G3V0E5", "TFRC",
  "Leucine-rich repeat transmembrane neuronal protein 2", "LRRT2", "O43300", "LRRTM2"
)

# Check the data
head(candidate_proteins)
names(candidate_proteins)

candidate_genes <- unique(candidate_proteins$Gene)
```


# 2. File paths for deCODE pQTL data
```{r}

pqtl_dir <- mr_data_dir

# List all pQTL files
pqtl_files <- list.files(
  pqtl_dir,
  pattern = "\\.txt\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Remove empty files
file_info <- file.info(pqtl_files)
pqtl_files <- rownames(file_info)[file_info$size > 1e6]

# Keep only files matching your candidate genes
pqtl_files <- pqtl_files[
  str_detect(
    basename(pqtl_files),
    paste(candidate_genes, collapse = "|")
  )
]

print(basename(pqtl_files))
```


# 3. Read and combine deCODE pQTL data
```{r}

pqtl_list <- list()

for (file in pqtl_files) {
  
  temp_pqtl <- fread(file)
  
  gene_name <- str_extract(
    basename(file),
    paste(candidate_genes, collapse = "|")
  )
  
  assay_id <- sub("\\.txt\\.gz$", "", basename(file))
  
  temp_pqtl$gene_name <- gene_name
  temp_pqtl$assay_id <- assay_id
  
  pqtl_list[[assay_id]] <- temp_pqtl
}

decode_pqtl <- rbindlist(pqtl_list, fill = TRUE)

head(decode_pqtl)
names(decode_pqtl)

# Save for later
#save(decode_pqtl, file = file.path(mr_data_dir, "decode_pqtl.RData"))

#load for later use
load(file.path(mr_data_dir, "decode_pqtl.RData"))
```


# 4. Standardise deCODE pQTL columns
```{r}

decode_std <- decode_pqtl %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene_name,
    chr = as.character(Chrom),
    pos = as.integer(Pos),
    variant_id = as.character(Name),
    rsid = sub("[,;].*$", "", as.character(rsids)),
    beta = as.numeric(Beta),
    se = as.numeric(SE),
    pval = as.numeric(Pval),
    effect_allele = toupper(as.character(effectAllele)),
    other_allele = toupper(as.character(otherAllele)),
    maf = as.numeric(ImpMAF),
    n = as.numeric(N)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(rsid),
    rsid != "",
    rsid != ".",
    str_detect(rsid, "^rs"),
    !is.na(beta),
    !is.na(se),
    !is.na(pval),
    effect_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T"),
    other_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T")
  )

head(decode_std)
names(decode_std)



```

```{r}
save(decode_std, file = file.path(mr_data_dir, "decode_std.RData"))
```



# 5. Keep cis pQTLs for your candidate proteins
```{r}
pqtl_candidates <- decode_std

# If cis/trans annotation exists, filter for cis
if ("cis_trans" %in% names(pqtl_candidates)) {
  pqtl_candidates <- pqtl_candidates %>%
    filter(cis_trans == "cis")
}

cat("\n=== SNPs per gene before significance filtering ===\n")
print(table(pqtl_candidates$gene))
```

```{r}
}
```

# 7. Format exposure data: SNP -> protein
```{r}
pqtl_sig_df <- data.frame(pqtl_sig)

pqtl_sig_df$chr <- gsub("^chr", "", pqtl_sig_df$chr)

exposure_dat <- format_data(
  pqtl_sig_df,
  type = "exposure",
  snp_col = "rsid",
  beta_col = "beta",
  se_col = "se",
  effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",
  other_allele_col = "other_allele",
  pval_col = "pval",
  samplesize_col = "n",
  chr_col = "chr",
  pos_col = "pos",
  eaf_col = "maf",
  phenotype_col = "gene"
)

save(exposure_dat, file = "exposure_dat.RData")
```

#8. LD clumping
```{r}

configure_opengwas()

# Run LD clumping
exposure_clumped <- clump_data(
  exposure_dat,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.001,
  clump_p1 = 1,
  pop = "EUR"
)

cat("\n=== SNPs after LD clumping per gene ===\n")
print(table(exposure_clumped$exposure))

# Check if any genes remain after clumping
if (nrow(exposure_clumped) == 0) {
  stop("No SNPs remaining after LD clumping!")
}

# Save exposure_clumped for later use
save(exposure_clumped, file = "exposure_clumped.RData")
cat("\n✓ exposure_clumped saved to exposure_clumped.RData\n")



##alternative way
# ============================================================
# Configure OpenGWAS and run clumping
# ============================================================

# Read the credential from the local environment without displaying it.
configure_opengwas()

# Run LD clumping
cat("\nRunning LD clumping...\n")
exposure_clumped <- clump_data(
  exposure_dat,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.001,
  clump_p1 = 1,
  pop = "EUR"
)

# Check results
if (exists("exposure_clumped") && !is.null(exposure_clumped) && nrow(exposure_clumped) > 0) {
  cat("\n=== SNPs after LD clumping per gene ===\n")
  print(table(exposure_clumped$exposure))
  cat("\nTotal SNPs after clumping:", nrow(exposure_clumped), "\n")
  
  # Save for later
  save(exposure_clumped, file = "exposure_clumped.RData")
  cat("✓ exposure_clumped saved to exposure_clumped.RData\n")
} else {
  cat("\n⚠️ LD clumping failed or returned no SNPs.\n")
  cat("Falling back to manual selection...\n")
  
  # Fallback: Keep most significant SNP per gene
  pval_col <- names(exposure_dat)[grepl("pval", names(exposure_dat), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  if (is.na(pval_col)) {
    stop("No p-value column found in exposure_dat!")
  }
  
  cat("Using p-value column:", pval_col, "\n")
  
  exposure_clumped <- exposure_dat %>%
    group_by(exposure) %>%
    arrange(!!sym(pval_col)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  cat("\n=== SNPs kept (most significant per gene, fallback method) ===\n")
  print(table(exposure_clumped$exposure))
  cat("Total SNPs kept:", nrow(exposure_clumped), "\n")
  
  save(exposure_clumped, file = "exposure_clumped.RData")
  cat("✓ exposure_clumped saved to exposure_clumped.RData\n")
}
```

# 12. Run MR for BOTH outcomes
```{r}

run_mr_analysis <- function(harmonised_data, outcome_label) {
  
  if (is.null(harmonised_data) || nrow(harmonised_data) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No harmonised SNPs available for", outcome_label))
  }
  
  cat("\nRunning MR for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  cat("Total harmonised SNP rows:", nrow(harmonised_data), "\n")
  cat("Proteins included:\n")
  print(table(harmonised_data$exposure))
  
  # Main MR
  mr_results <- mr(
    harmonised_data,
    method_list = c(
      "mr_wald_ratio",
      "mr_ivw",
      "mr_weighted_median",
      "mr_egger_regression"
    )
  )
  
  # Add multiple testing correction
  # This adjusts across all proteins and MR methods within each outcome
  mr_results <- mr_results %>%
    group_by(outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      p_FDR = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"),
      p_Bonferroni = p.adjust(pval, method = "bonferroni")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Sensitivity analyses with error protection
  heterogeneity <- tryCatch(
    mr_heterogeneity(harmonised_data),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Heterogeneity test failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  pleiotropy <- tryCatch(
    mr_pleiotropy_test(harmonised_data),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Pleiotropy test failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  leaveoneout <- tryCatch(
    mr_leaveoneout(harmonised_data),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Leave-one-out analysis failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  return(list(
    mr_results = mr_results,
    heterogeneity = heterogeneity,
    pleiotropy = pleiotropy,
    leaveoneout = leaveoneout,
    harmonised_data = harmonised_data
  ))
}

cat("\n=== Running MR for Creatinine eGFR ===\n")
results_creat <- run_mr_analysis(dat_egfr_creat, "Creatinine eGFR")

cat("\n=== Running MR for Cystatin-C eGFR ===\n")
results_cys <- run_mr_analysis(dat_egfr_cys, "Cystatin-C eGFR")
```

# 14. Plots for BOTH outcomes with PDF saving (ENHANCED VERSION)

```{r}


plot_mr_results <- function(results, 
                            outcome_label, 
                            save_pdf = TRUE, 
                            pdf_dir = "MR_plots_forward",
                            width = 12,
                            height = 10,
                            include_scatter = TRUE,
                            include_combined = TRUE,
                            print_plots = TRUE) {
  
  # Create directory for PDFs if it doesn't exist
  if (save_pdf && !dir.exists(pdf_dir)) {
    dir.create(pdf_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
    cat("✓ Created directory:", pdf_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  # Generate single SNP data
  single_snp <- mr_singlesnp(results$harmonised_data)
  
  # Initialize list to store plots
  all_plots <- list()
  
  # ============================================================
  # 1. Forest Plot
  # ============================================================
  
  cat("\n✓ Generating Forest Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  forest_plot <- mr_forest_plot(single_snp)
  if (print_plots) print(forest_plot)
  all_plots$forest <- forest_plot
  
  if (save_pdf) {
    pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("1_forest_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
    pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
    print(forest_plot)
    dev.off()
    cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 2. Funnel Plot
  # ============================================================
  
  cat("✓ Generating Funnel Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  funnel_plot <- mr_funnel_plot(single_snp)
  if (print_plots) print(funnel_plot)
  all_plots$funnel <- funnel_plot
  
  if (save_pdf) {
    pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("2_funnel_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
    pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
    print(funnel_plot)
    dev.off()
    cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 3. Leave-One-Out Plot
  # ============================================================
  
  cat("✓ Generating Leave-One-Out Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  loo_plot <- mr_leaveoneout_plot(results$leaveoneout)
  if (print_plots) print(loo_plot)
  all_plots$loo <- loo_plot
  
  if (save_pdf) {
    pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("3_leaveoneout_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
    pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
    print(loo_plot)
    dev.off()
    cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 4. Scatter Plot (optional)
  # ============================================================
  
  if (include_scatter) {
    cat("✓ Generating Scatter Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    mr_results_all <- mr(results$harmonised_data)
    scatter_plot <- mr_scatter_plot(
      mr_results = mr_results_all, 
      dat = results$harmonised_data
    )
    if (print_plots) print(scatter_plot)
    all_plots$scatter <- scatter_plot
    
    if (save_pdf) {
      pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("4_scatter_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
      pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
      print(scatter_plot)
      dev.off()
      cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 5. Combined PDF with all plots
  # ============================================================
  
  if (save_pdf && include_combined) {
    cat("✓ Generating Combined PDF for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    
    combined_pdf <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("ALL_plots_combined_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
    pdf(combined_pdf, width = width, height = height)
    
    # Title page with metadata
    plot.new()
    text(0.5, 0.7, "MENDELIAN RANDOMIZATION ANALYSIS", cex = 2.2, font = 2)
    text(0.5, 0.6, "Protein → eGFR (Forward MR)", cex = 1.8, font = 2)
    text(0.5, 0.48, outcome_label, cex = 1.4, col = "darkblue")
    text(0.5, 0.4, paste("Analysis Date:", Sys.Date()), cex = 1.2)
    text(0.5, 0.35, paste("Number of SNPs:", nrow(single_snp)), cex = 1.2)
    
    # Extract IVW results for summary
    ivw_results <- results$mr_results %>% 
      filter(method == "Inverse variance weighted")
    
    if (nrow(ivw_results) > 0) {
      text(0.5, 0.25, paste("IVW Estimate (Beta):", round(ivw_results$b[1], 4)), cex = 1.1)
      text(0.5, 0.2, paste("IVW P-value:", format(ivw_results$pval[1], scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)), cex = 1.1)
    }
    
    # Add all plots
    print(forest_plot)
    print(funnel_plot)
    print(loo_plot)
    if (include_scatter) {
      print(scatter_plot)
    }
    
    dev.off()
    cat("  → Saved:", basename(combined_pdf), "\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n✓ All plots completed for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  
  # Return plots invisibly
  invisible(all_plots)
}

# ============================================================
# Generate and save plots for both outcomes
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Clean and robust MR plotting code
# Save plots to: results/MR_plots_forward
# ============================================================

library(TwoSampleMR)
library(dplyr)

}

  dir.create(plots_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

cat("Plots will be saved here:\n")
cat(normalizePath(plots_dir, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")


# ============================================================
# Helper: convert TwoSampleMR plot output to a list
# ============================================================

as_plot_list <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(list())
  }
  
  if (inherits(x, "ggplot")) {
    return(list(x))
  }
  
  if (is.list(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  
  return(list(x))
}


# ============================================================
# Helper: save plots safely as PDFs
# ============================================================

save_plot_list_pdf <- function(plot_object, file_prefix, pdf_dir, width = 12, height = 10) {
  
  plot_list <- as_plot_list(plot_object)
  
  if (length(plot_list) == 0) {
    cat("No plots to save for:", file_prefix, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  for (i in seq_along(plot_list)) {
    
    pdf_file <- file.path(
      pdf_dir,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_", i, ".pdf")
    )
    
    grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height, useDingbats = FALSE)
    
    tryCatch(
      {
        print(plot_list[[i]])
      },
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Could not print plot:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
        cat("Error:", e$message, "\n")
      },
      finally = {
        grDevices::dev.off()
      }
    )
    
    cat("Saved:", pdf_file, "\n")
  }
}


# ============================================================
# Main plotting function
# ============================================================

plot_mr_results_simple <- function(results,
                                   outcome_label,
                                   pdf_dir = plots_dir,
                                   width = 12,
                                   height = 10) {
  
  if (is.null(results)) {
    stop("results object is NULL")
  }
  
  if (is.null(results$harmonised_data) || nrow(results$harmonised_data) == 0) {
    stop("No harmonised data found for ", outcome_label)
  }
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Generating plots for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  cat("Saving to:", pdf_dir, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  # Single-SNP results
  single_snp <- tryCatch(
    mr_singlesnp(results$harmonised_data),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("mr_singlesnp failed:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(single_snp) || nrow(single_snp) == 0) {
    cat("No single-SNP results available for", outcome_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Forest plot
  forest_plot <- tryCatch(
    mr_forest_plot(single_snp),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Forest plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  save_plot_list_pdf(
    forest_plot,
    paste0("1_forest_plot_", outcome_label),
    pdf_dir,
    width,
    height
  )
  
  # Funnel plot
  funnel_plot <- tryCatch(
    mr_funnel_plot(single_snp),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Funnel plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  save_plot_list_pdf(
    funnel_plot,
    paste0("2_funnel_plot_", outcome_label),
    pdf_dir,
    width,
    height
  )
  
  # Leave-one-out plot
  if (!is.null(results$leaveoneout) && nrow(results$leaveoneout) > 0) {
    
    loo_plot <- tryCatch(
      mr_leaveoneout_plot(results$leaveoneout),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Leave-one-out plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    save_plot_list_pdf(
      loo_plot,
      paste0("3_leaveoneout_plot_", outcome_label),
      pdf_dir,
      width,
      height
    )
    
  } else {
    cat("Leave-one-out plot skipped for", outcome_label, "\n")
  }
  
  # Scatter plot
  scatter_plot <- tryCatch(
    mr_scatter_plot(
      mr_results = results$mr_results,
      dat = results$harmonised_data
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Scatter plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  save_plot_list_pdf(
    scatter_plot,
    paste0("4_scatter_plot_", outcome_label),
    pdf_dir,
    width,
    height
  )
  
  cat("\nFinished plots for:", outcome_label, "\n")
}


# ============================================================
# Run plotting for both outcomes
# ============================================================

plot_mr_results_simple(
  results = results_creat,
  outcome_label = "eGFRcrea_Stanzick2021",
  pdf_dir = plots_dir
)

plot_mr_results_simple(
```

# 15. Summary comparison table with cross-outcome FDR
```{r}


compare_results <- function(creat_results, cys_results) {
  # Extract significant results (p < 0.05)
  creat_sig <- creat_results$mr_results %>%
    filter(pval < 0.05) %>%
    select(exposure, outcome, method, b, se, pval, p_FDR)
  
  cys_sig <- cys_results$mr_results %>%
    filter(pval < 0.05) %>%
    select(exposure, outcome, method, b, se, pval, p_FDR)
  
  cat("\n=== Significant results for Creatinine eGFR ===\n")
  if (nrow(creat_sig) > 0) {
    print(creat_sig)
  } else {
    cat("No significant results found\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n=== Significant results for Cystatin-C eGFR ===\n")
  if (nrow(cys_sig) > 0) {
    print(cys_sig)
  } else {
    cat("No significant results found\n")
  }
  
  # Combine and save
  combined <- bind_rows(
    mutate(creat_sig, outcome_type = "Creatinine"),
    mutate(cys_sig, outcome_type = "Cystatin-C")
  )
  
  # Add cross-outcome FDR correction
  if (nrow(combined) > 0) {
    combined <- combined %>%
      mutate(
        cross_outcome_FDR = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"),
        cross_outcome_Bonferroni = p.adjust(pval, method = "bonferroni")
      )
  }
  
  write.csv(combined, "MR_significant_results_comparison.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(combined)
}

# Generate comparison
comparison_table <- compare_results(results_creat, results_cys)
```

```{r}
pqtl_list <- list()

for (file in pqtl_files) {

    basename(file),
    paste(candidate_genes, collapse = "|")

  temp_pqtl$gene_name <- gene_name
  temp_pqtl$assay_id <- assay_id
  
  pqtl_list[[assay_id]] <- temp_pqtl
```

```{r}
    !is.na(pval),
    effect_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T"),
```

# 7. Extract eGFR instruments
```{r}
# 8. Extract eGFR instruments
# ============================================================

extract_egfr_instruments <- function(gwas_data, p_threshold = 5e-8) {
  gwas_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(P.value), P.value < p_threshold) %>%
    transmute(
      rsid = as.character(RSID),
      beta = as.numeric(Effect),
      se = as.numeric(StdErr),
      effect_allele = toupper(as.character(Allele1)),
      other_allele = toupper(as.character(Allele2)),
      eaf = as.numeric(Freq1),
      pval = as.numeric(P.value),
      samplesize = as.numeric(n),
      chr = as.character(chr),
      pos = as.integer(pos)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(rsid),
      rsid != "",
      rsid != ".",
      str_detect(rsid, "^rs"),
      !is.na(beta),
      !is.na(se),
      !is.na(pval),
      effect_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T"),
      other_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T")
    )
}
```

# 8. Format eGFR as exposure
```{r}

# ============================================================
# 9. Format eGFR data as TwoSampleMR exposure data
# ============================================================

format_egfr_exposure <- function(
    egfr_data,
    exposure_name
) {

  if (nrow(egfr_data) == 0) {
    stop("The exposure dataset is empty: ", exposure_name)
  }

  egfr_input <- egfr_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      phenotype = exposure_name
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  exposure_dat <- TwoSampleMR::format_data(
    dat = egfr_input,
    type = "exposure",
    phenotype_col = "phenotype",
    snp_col = "rsid",
    beta_col = "beta",
    se_col = "se",
    effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",
    other_allele_col = "other_allele",
    eaf_col = "eaf",
    pval_col = "pval",
    samplesize_col = "samplesize",
    chr_col = "chr",
    pos_col = "pos"
  )

  # Keep a stable and descriptive identifier.
  exposure_dat$exposure <- exposure_name
  exposure_dat$id.exposure <- exposure_name

  exposure_dat
}

exposure_egfr_creat <- format_egfr_exposure(
  egfr_creat_instruments,
  exposure_name = "eGFRcrea_Stanzick2021"
)

exposure_egfr_cys <- format_egfr_exposure(
```

# 10. Prepare deCODE protein data as outcome
```{r}
# 11. Prepare deCODE protein data as outcome
# ============================================================

prepare_pqtl_outcome <- function(pqtl_data, exposure_snps, gene_list) {
  
  outcome_data <- pqtl_data %>%
    filter(
      rsid %in% exposure_snps,
      gene %in% gene_list
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      SNP = rsid,
      beta.outcome = beta,
      se.outcome = se,
      effect_allele.outcome = effect_allele,
      other_allele.outcome = other_allele,
      pval.outcome = pval,
      samplesize.outcome = n,
      outcome = gene,
      id.outcome = gene
    )
  
  return(outcome_data)
}

  decode_std,
  exposure_clumped_egfr_creat$SNP,
  candidate_genes
)

  decode_std,
  exposure_clumped_egfr_cys$SNP,
```

# 12. Run reverse MR
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 12. Run reverse MR
# ============================================================

run_reverse_mr <- function(harmonise_data, direction_label) {
  if (is.null(harmonise_data) || nrow(harmonise_data) == 0) {
    cat("⚠️ No SNPs available for", direction_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("\nRunning reverse MR for:", direction_label, "\n")
  
  mr_results <- mr(
    harmonise_data,
    method_list = c(
      "mr_wald_ratio",
      "mr_ivw",
      "mr_weighted_median",
      "mr_egger_regression"
    )
  )
  
  mr_results <- mr_results %>%
    group_by(outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      p_FDR = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"),
      p_Bonferroni = p.adjust(pval, method = "bonferroni")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  mr_results$direction <- direction_label
  
  heterogeneity <- tryCatch(mr_heterogeneity(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  pleiotropy <- tryCatch(mr_pleiotropy_test(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  leaveoneout <- tryCatch(mr_leaveoneout(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  single_snp <- tryCatch(mr_singlesnp(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  return(list(
    mr_results = mr_results,
    heterogeneity = heterogeneity,
    pleiotropy = pleiotropy,
    leaveoneout = leaveoneout,
    single_snp = single_snp,
    harmonised_data = harmonise_data
  ))
}
```

# Revised reverse-MR analysis
```{r}
# ============================================================
# REVERSE MR: eGFR -> PROTEIN
# Run each protein separately and correct across proteins
# ============================================================

library(TwoSampleMR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# ============================================================
# 1. Helper function: run an analysis separately for each protein
# ============================================================

run_by_protein <- function(
    harmonised_data,
    analysis_function,
    analysis_name,
    ...
) {

  if (
    is.null(harmonised_data) ||
    nrow(harmonised_data) == 0
  ) {
    message("No harmonised data available for ", analysis_name)
    return(tibble())
  }

  proteins <- sort(unique(harmonised_data$outcome))

  result_list <- lapply(
    proteins,
    function(protein_name) {

      protein_data <- harmonised_data %>%
        filter(outcome == protein_name)

      tryCatch(
        {
          result <- analysis_function(
            protein_data,
            ...
          )

          result
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message(
            analysis_name,
            " failed for ",
            protein_name,
            ": ",
            e$message
          )

          NULL
        }
      )
    }
  )

  bind_rows(result_list)
}


# ============================================================
# 2. Helper function: multiple-testing correction
#    across proteins within one MR method
# ============================================================

adjust_method_across_proteins <- function(
    mr_results,
    method_name,
    analysis_type,
    number_of_proteins
) {

  method_results <- mr_results %>%
    filter(method == method_name)

  if (nrow(method_results) == 0) {
    message("No results found for method: ", method_name)
    return(tibble())
  }

  if (nrow(method_results) != number_of_proteins) {
    warning(
      method_name,
      " returned ",
      nrow(method_results),
      " results, but ",
      number_of_proteins,
      " proteins were included."
    )
  }

  method_results %>%
    mutate(
      analysis_type = analysis_type,

      correction_family = paste0(
        method_name,
        " across ",
        number_of_proteins,
        " proteins"
      ),

      number_of_tests = number_of_proteins,

      Bonferroni_threshold =
        0.05 / number_of_proteins,

      # Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across proteins
      p_FDR = p.adjust(
        pval,
        method = "BH",
        n = number_of_proteins
      ),

      # Bonferroni correction across proteins
      p_Bonferroni = p.adjust(
        pval,
        method = "bonferroni",
        n = number_of_proteins
      ),

      significant_nominal =
        pval < 0.05,

      significant_FDR =
        p_FDR < 0.05,

      significant_Bonferroni =
        p_Bonferroni < 0.05
    ) %>%
    arrange(pval)
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Main reverse-MR function
# ============================================================

run_reverse_mr <- function(
    harmonised_data,
    direction_label
) {

  if (
    is.null(harmonised_data) ||
    nrow(harmonised_data) == 0
  ) {
    message("No SNPs available for ", direction_label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Keep only rows approved for MR, if mr_keep is available
  if ("mr_keep" %in% names(harmonised_data)) {
    harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
      filter(mr_keep == TRUE)
  }

  if (nrow(harmonised_data) == 0) {
    message(
      "No SNPs remained after harmonisation for ",
      direction_label
    )

    return(NULL)
  }

  protein_names <- sort(
    unique(harmonised_data$outcome)
  )

  number_of_proteins <- length(protein_names)

  Bonferroni_threshold <-
    0.05 / number_of_proteins

  cat(
    "\n=================================================\n",
    "Reverse MR direction: ", direction_label, "\n",
    "Proteins analysed: ", number_of_proteins, "\n",
    "Protein names: ",
    paste(protein_names, collapse = ", "),
    "\nBonferroni threshold per method: ",
    Bonferroni_threshold,
    "\n=================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # A. Count SNPs used for each protein
  # ==========================================================

  snp_counts <- harmonised_data %>%
    distinct(outcome, SNP) %>%
    count(
      outcome,
      name = "number_of_SNPs"
    ) %>%
    arrange(outcome)

  cat("\nSNPs used for each protein:\n")
  print(snp_counts)


  # ==========================================================
  # B. Run the three MR methods separately for each protein
  # ==========================================================

  mr_results_raw <- run_by_protein(
    harmonised_data = harmonised_data,
    analysis_function = TwoSampleMR::mr,
    analysis_name = "MR analysis",
    method_list = c(
      "mr_ivw",
      "mr_weighted_median",
      "mr_egger_regression"
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = direction_label
    )

  cat("\nNumber of results produced by method:\n")

  print(
    table(
      mr_results_raw$method,
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # C. Primary analysis: IVW
  #    Correction across proteins only
  # ==========================================================

  primary_ivw <- adjust_method_across_proteins(
    mr_results = mr_results_raw,
    method_name = "Inverse variance weighted",
    analysis_type = "Primary analysis",
    number_of_proteins = number_of_proteins
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # D. Sensitivity analysis: weighted median
  #    Corrected separately across proteins
  # ==========================================================

  sensitivity_weighted_median <-
    adjust_method_across_proteins(
      mr_results = mr_results_raw,
      method_name = "Weighted median",
      analysis_type = "Sensitivity analysis",
      number_of_proteins = number_of_proteins
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # E. Sensitivity analysis: MR-Egger
  #    Corrected separately across proteins
  # ==========================================================

  sensitivity_mr_egger <-
    adjust_method_across_proteins(
      mr_results = mr_results_raw,
      method_name = "MR Egger",
      analysis_type = "Sensitivity analysis",
      number_of_proteins = number_of_proteins
    )


  # Combine adjusted results while preserving separate
  # correction families
  mr_results_adjusted <- bind_rows(
    primary_ivw,
    sensitivity_weighted_median,
    sensitivity_mr_egger
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # F. Heterogeneity analysis
  # ==========================================================

  heterogeneity_raw <- run_by_protein(
    harmonised_data = harmonised_data,
    analysis_function =
      TwoSampleMR::mr_heterogeneity,
    analysis_name = "Heterogeneity analysis"
  )

  if (nrow(heterogeneity_raw) > 0) {

    heterogeneity <- heterogeneity_raw %>%
      group_by(method) %>%
      mutate(
        number_of_tests =
          number_of_proteins,

        Q_Bonferroni_threshold =
          0.05 / number_of_proteins,

        Q_p_FDR = p.adjust(
          Q_pval,
          method = "BH",
          n = number_of_proteins
        ),

        Q_p_Bonferroni = p.adjust(
          Q_pval,
          method = "bonferroni",
          n = number_of_proteins
        ),

        significant_heterogeneity_nominal =
          Q_pval < 0.05,

        significant_heterogeneity_FDR =
          Q_p_FDR < 0.05,

        significant_heterogeneity_Bonferroni =
          Q_p_Bonferroni < 0.05
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(method, Q_pval)

  } else {
    heterogeneity <- tibble()
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # G. MR-Egger intercept test for directional pleiotropy
  #    One test per protein
  # ==========================================================

  pleiotropy_raw <- run_by_protein(
    harmonised_data = harmonised_data,
    analysis_function =
      TwoSampleMR::mr_pleiotropy_test,
    analysis_name =
      "MR-Egger intercept analysis"
  )

  if (nrow(pleiotropy_raw) > 0) {

    pleiotropy <- pleiotropy_raw %>%
      mutate(
        number_of_tests =
          number_of_proteins,

        Bonferroni_threshold =
          0.05 / number_of_proteins,

        p_FDR = p.adjust(
          pval,
          method = "BH",
          n = number_of_proteins
        ),

        p_Bonferroni = p.adjust(
          pval,
          method = "bonferroni",
          n = number_of_proteins
        ),

        significant_pleiotropy_nominal =
          pval < 0.05,

        significant_pleiotropy_FDR =
          p_FDR < 0.05,

        significant_pleiotropy_Bonferroni =
          p_Bonferroni < 0.05
      ) %>%
      arrange(pval)

  } else {
    pleiotropy <- tibble()
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # H. Leave-one-out analysis
  # Diagnostic analysis: no protein-level correction applied
  # ==========================================================

  leaveoneout <- run_by_protein(
    harmonised_data = harmonised_data,
    analysis_function =
      TwoSampleMR::mr_leaveoneout,
    analysis_name =
      "Leave-one-out analysis"
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # I. Single-SNP analysis
  # Diagnostic analysis: no protein-level correction applied
  # ==========================================================

  single_snp <- run_by_protein(
    harmonised_data = harmonised_data,
    analysis_function =
      TwoSampleMR::mr_singlesnp,
    analysis_name =
      "Single-SNP analysis"
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # J. Significant-result summaries
  # ==========================================================

  significant_primary_ivw <- primary_ivw %>%
    filter(significant_Bonferroni == TRUE)

  significant_weighted_median <-
    sensitivity_weighted_median %>%
    filter(significant_Bonferroni == TRUE)

  significant_mr_egger <-
    sensitivity_mr_egger %>%
    filter(significant_Bonferroni == TRUE)


  # ==========================================================
  # K. Return all results
  # ==========================================================

  list(
    direction = direction_label,

    number_of_proteins =
      number_of_proteins,

    protein_names =
      protein_names,

    Bonferroni_threshold =
      Bonferroni_threshold,

    snp_counts =
      snp_counts,

    mr_results_raw =
      mr_results_raw,

    mr_results_adjusted =
      mr_results_adjusted,

    primary_ivw =
      primary_ivw,

    sensitivity_weighted_median =
      sensitivity_weighted_median,

    sensitivity_mr_egger =
      sensitivity_mr_egger,

    significant_primary_ivw =
      significant_primary_ivw,

    significant_weighted_median =
      significant_weighted_median,

    significant_mr_egger =
      significant_mr_egger,

    heterogeneity =
      heterogeneity,

    pleiotropy =
      pleiotropy,

    leaveoneout =
      leaveoneout,

    single_snp =
      single_snp,

    harmonised_data =
      harmonised_data
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. Helper function to save outputs
# ============================================================

save_reverse_mr_results <- function(
    results,
    file_prefix,
    output_directory =
      "MR_results_reverse"
) {

  if (is.null(results)) {
    message(
      "No results available for ",
      file_prefix
    )

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  dir.create(
    output_directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  analysis_date <- format(
    Sys.Date(),
    "%Y%m%d"
  )

  save_table <- function(
      object,
      suffix
  ) {

    if (
      !is.null(object) &&
      is.data.frame(object) &&
      nrow(object) > 0
    ) {

      output_file <- file.path(
        output_directory,
        paste0(
          file_prefix,
          "_",
          suffix,
          "_",
          analysis_date,
          ".csv"
        )
      )

      write.csv(
        object,
        file = output_file,
        row.names = FALSE,
        fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
      )

      cat(
        "Saved: ",
        output_file,
        "\n",
        sep = ""
      )
    }
  }


  # SNP counts
  save_table(
    results$snp_counts,
    "SNP_counts"
  )

  # All MR results
  save_table(
    results$mr_results_raw,
    "all_methods_raw"
  )

  save_table(
    results$mr_results_adjusted,
    "all_methods_adjusted"
  )

  # Primary IVW results
  save_table(
    results$primary_ivw,
    "primary_IVW"
  )

  save_table(
    results$significant_primary_ivw,
    "primary_IVW_significant"
  )

  # Weighted-median sensitivity analysis
  save_table(
    results$sensitivity_weighted_median,
    "sensitivity_weighted_median"
  )

  save_table(
    results$significant_weighted_median,
    "sensitivity_weighted_median_significant"
  )

  # MR-Egger sensitivity analysis
  save_table(
    results$sensitivity_mr_egger,
    "sensitivity_MR_Egger"
  )

  save_table(
    results$significant_mr_egger,
    "sensitivity_MR_Egger_significant"
  )

  # Sensitivity diagnostics
  save_table(
    results$heterogeneity,
    "heterogeneity"
  )

  save_table(
    results$pleiotropy,
    "pleiotropy"
  )

  save_table(
    results$leaveoneout,
    "leaveoneout"
  )

  save_table(
    results$single_snp,
    "single_SNP"
  )

  # Harmonised data
  save_table(
    results$harmonised_data,
    "harmonised"
  )

  invisible(NULL)
}

    "reverse_eGFRcys_to_protein"
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Confirm the correction thresholds
# ============================================================

if (!is.null(reverse_creat)) {

  cat(
    "\neGFRcrea proteins tested: ",
    reverse_creat$number_of_proteins,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  cat(
    "eGFRcrea Bonferroni threshold: ",
    reverse_creat$Bonferroni_threshold,
    "\n",

  )
}

if (!is.null(reverse_cys)) {

    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

    "eGFRcys Bonferroni threshold: ",
    reverse_cys$Bonferroni_threshold,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 12. Show output directory

cat(

)
```

#test for running sensitivity analysis for 1 protein 
```{r}
library(MRPRESSO)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert p-values such as "<0.001" to numeric values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_presso_pvalue <- function(x) {
  
  if (
    is.null(x) ||
    length(x) == 0 ||
    all(is.na(x))
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  x <- trimws(as.character(x)[1])
  
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      sub("^<\\s*", "", x)
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract a named value safely
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_named_value <- function(
    x,
    possible_names
) {
  
  if (
    is.null(x) ||
    is.null(names(x))
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  matched_name <- intersect(
    possible_names,
    names(x)
  )
  
  if (length(matched_name) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  value <- x[[matched_name[1]]]
  
  if (length(value) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  value[1]
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract the MR-PRESSO global-test object
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_presso_global_test <- function(fit) {
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  presso_results <- fit[["MR-PRESSO results"]]
  
  if (is.null(presso_results)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (
    !is.null(names(presso_results)) &&
    "Global Test" %in% names(presso_results)
  ) {
    return(
      presso_results[["Global Test"]]
    )
  }
  
  presso_results
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean harmonised data before MR-PRESSO
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_presso_data <- function(harmonised_data) {
  
  required_columns <- c(
    "SNP",
    "beta.exposure",
    "se.exposure",
    "beta.outcome",
    "se.outcome",
    "exposure",
    "outcome",
    "id.exposure",
    "id.outcome"
  )
  
  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(harmonised_data)
  )
  
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }
  
  dat <- as.data.frame(
    harmonised_data
  )
  
  if ("mr_keep" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(
        mr_keep %in% TRUE
      )
  }
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      SNP = as.character(SNP),
      exposure = as.character(exposure),
      outcome = as.character(outcome),
      id.exposure = as.character(id.exposure),
      id.outcome = as.character(id.outcome),
      
      beta.exposure =
        as.numeric(beta.exposure),
      
      se.exposure =
        as.numeric(se.exposure),
      
      beta.outcome =
        as.numeric(beta.outcome),
      
      se.outcome =
        as.numeric(se.outcome)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(SNP),
      SNP != "",
      is.finite(beta.exposure),
      is.finite(se.exposure),
      is.finite(beta.outcome),
      is.finite(se.outcome),
      se.exposure > 0,
      se.outcome > 0
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      id.exposure,
      id.outcome,
      SNP,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
  
  dat
}

# ============================================================
# ONE-PROTEIN MR-PRESSO GLOBAL TEST
# Example: eGFRcrea -> B2M
```

# Global MR-PRESSO test for all proteins with 1,000 simulations 

```{r}
############################Then run for all the proteins with simulation of 1000#####################

# ============================================================
# GLOBAL MR-PRESSO SCREENING FOR ALL PROTEINS
# ============================================================

run_presso_global_all <- function(
    harmonised_data,
    direction_label,
    nb_distribution = 1000L,
    significance_threshold = 0.05,
    seed = 1234L
) {
  
  dat <- clean_presso_data(
    harmonised_data
  )
  
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No valid harmonised SNPs remained after cleaning."
    )
  }
  
  
  # Split data into separate exposure-outcome analyses
  groups <- dat %>%
    group_by(
      id.exposure,
      id.outcome,
      exposure,
      outcome
    ) %>%
    group_split(
      .keep = TRUE
    )
  
  
  summary_results <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(groups)
  )
  
  
  complete_fits <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(groups)
  )
  
  
  fit_names <- character(
    length(groups)
  )
  
  
  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    
    x <- as.data.frame(
      groups[[i]]
    )
    
    
    exposure_name <- as.character(
      x$exposure[1]
    )
    
    
    outcome_name <- as.character(
      x$outcome[1]
    )
    
    
    exposure_id <- as.character(
      x$id.exposure[1]
    )
    
    
    outcome_id <- as.character(
      x$id.outcome[1]
    )
    
    
    nsnp <- nrow(x)
    
    
    fit_names[i] <- paste(
      exposure_name,
      outcome_name,
      sep = "__"
    )
    
    
    cat(
      "\nGlobal test ",
      i,
      " of ",
      length(groups),
      ": ",
      exposure_name,
      " -> ",
      outcome_name,
      " | SNPs: ",
      nsnp,
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    
    flush.console()
    
    
    # MR-PRESSO requires at least four SNPs
    if (nsnp < 4) {
      
      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction =
          direction_label,
        
        exposure =
          exposure_name,
        
        outcome =
          outcome_name,
        
        id.exposure =
          exposure_id,
        
        id.outcome =
          outcome_id,
        
        nsnp =
          nsnp,
        
        nb_distribution =
          as.integer(nb_distribution),
        
        global_RSSobs =
          NA_real_,
        
        global_p_reported =
          NA_character_,
        
        global_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        runtime_seconds =
          NA_real_,
        
        runtime_minutes =
          NA_real_,
        
        status =
          "Not run: fewer than four SNPs"
      )
      
      next
    }
    
    
    # Preserve SNP names
    rownames(x) <- make.unique(
      x$SNP
    )
    
    
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    
    fit <- tryCatch(
      {
        MRPRESSO::mr_presso(
          BetaOutcome =
            "beta.outcome",
          
          BetaExposure =
            "beta.exposure",
          
          SdOutcome =
            "se.outcome",
          
          SdExposure =
            "se.exposure",
          
          OUTLIERtest =
            FALSE,
          
          DISTORTIONtest =
            FALSE,
          
          data =
            x,
          
          NbDistribution =
            as.integer(nb_distribution),
          
          SignifThreshold =
            significance_threshold,
          
          seed =
            as.integer(seed + i)
        )
      },
      
      error = function(e) {
        e
      }
    )
    
    
    elapsed_seconds <- as.numeric(
      difftime(
        Sys.time(),
        start_time,
        units = "secs"
      )
    )
    
    
    # Record errors without stopping remaining proteins
    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      
      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction =
          direction_label,
        
        exposure =
          exposure_name,
        
        outcome =
          outcome_name,
        
        id.exposure =
          exposure_id,
        
        id.outcome =
          outcome_id,
        
        nsnp =
          nsnp,
        
        nb_distribution =
          as.integer(nb_distribution),
        
        global_RSSobs =
          NA_real_,
        
        global_p_reported =
          NA_character_,
        
        global_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        runtime_seconds =
          elapsed_seconds,
        
        runtime_minutes =
          elapsed_seconds / 60,
        
        status = paste(
          "MR-PRESSO error:",
          conditionMessage(fit)
        )
      )
      
      
      complete_fits[[i]] <- NULL
      
      
      cat(
        "Error: ",
        conditionMessage(fit),
        "\n",
        sep = ""
      )
      
      flush.console()
      
      next
    }
    
    
    complete_fits[[i]] <- fit
    
    
    # Extract global test
    global_test <- extract_presso_global_test(
      fit
    )
    
    
    if (is.null(global_test)) {
      
      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction =
          direction_label,
        
        exposure =
          exposure_name,
        
        outcome =
          outcome_name,
        
        id.exposure =
          exposure_id,
        
        id.outcome =
          outcome_id,
        
        nsnp =
          nsnp,
        
        nb_distribution =
          as.integer(nb_distribution),
        
        global_RSSobs =
          NA_real_,
        
        global_p_reported =
          NA_character_,
        
        global_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        runtime_seconds =
          elapsed_seconds,
        
        runtime_minutes =
          elapsed_seconds / 60,
        
        status =
          "Completed; global-test object unavailable"
      )
      
      next
    }
    
    
    global_rss <- extract_named_value(
      global_test,
      c(
        "RSSobs",
        "RSS"
      )
    )
    
    
    global_p_raw <- extract_named_value(
      global_test,
      c(
        "Pvalue",
        "P-value",
        "P.value"
      )
    )
    
    
    global_p_reported <- if (
      is.null(global_p_raw)
    ) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      as.character(global_p_raw)
    }
    
    
    global_p_numeric <- parse_presso_pvalue(
      global_p_reported
    )
    
    
    summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
      direction =
        direction_label,
      
      exposure =
        exposure_name,
      
      outcome =
        outcome_name,
      
      id.exposure =
        exposure_id,
      
      id.outcome =
        outcome_id,
      
      nsnp =
        nsnp,
      
      nb_distribution =
        as.integer(nb_distribution),
      
      global_RSSobs = if (
        is.null(global_rss)
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        as.numeric(global_rss)
      },
      
      global_p_reported =
        global_p_reported,
      
      global_p =
        global_p_numeric,
      
      runtime_seconds =
        elapsed_seconds,
      
      runtime_minutes =
        elapsed_seconds / 60,
      
      status = case_when(
        is.na(global_p_numeric) ~
          "Completed; global p-value unavailable",
        
        global_p_numeric <
          significance_threshold ~
          paste0(
            "Significant global test; ",
            "run full MR-PRESSO"
          ),
        
        TRUE ~
          "Global test not significant"
      )
    )
    
    
    cat(
      "Completed: ",
      outcome_name,
      " | Global p: ",
      global_p_reported,
      " | Time: ",
      round(
        elapsed_seconds / 60,
        2
      ),
      " minutes\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    
    flush.console()
  }
  
  
  names(complete_fits) <- make.unique(
    fit_names
  )
  
  
  summary_table <- bind_rows(
    summary_results
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      global_p_FDR_direction =
        p.adjust(
          global_p,
          method = "fdr"
        ),
      
      global_p_Bonferroni_direction =
        p.adjust(
          global_p,
          method = "bonferroni"
        )
    )
  
  
  return(
    list(
      summary =
        summary_table,
      
      fits =
        complete_fits,
      
      cleaned_input =
        dat
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# ALL PROTEINS: eGFRcys -> proteins
# ============================================================

if (!exists("dat_reverse_cys")) {
  stop(
    "Object 'dat_reverse_cys' was not found."
  )

set.seed(5678)


presso_global_cys <- run_presso_global_all(
```

##run the MR presso for all the significant proteisn of previous steps with 10,000 simulations

```{r}
###########now run for the specified proteins with p value less than 0.05 with 10,000 times smulations#############
# ============================================================
# FULL MR-PRESSO ANALYSIS
#
# Required objects from the global-screening step:
#   presso_global_creat
#   presso_global_cys
#
# Required harmonised datasets:
#   dat_reverse_creat
#   dat_reverse_cys
# ============================================================

library(MRPRESSO)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse MR-PRESSO p-values such as "<0.0001"
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_presso_pvalue <- function(x) {
  
  if (
    is.null(x) ||
    length(x) == 0L ||
    all(is.na(x))
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  x <- trimws(
    as.character(x)[1]
  )
  
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      sub(
        "^<\\s*",
        "",
        x
      )
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract a named value safely
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_named_value <- function(
    x,
    possible_names
) {
  
  if (
    is.null(x) ||
    is.null(names(x))
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  matching_name <- intersect(
    possible_names,
    names(x)
  )
  
  if (length(matching_name) == 0L) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  value <- x[[matching_name[1]]]
  
  if (length(value) == 0L) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  value[1]
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract one numeric value from a data frame
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_table_numeric <- function(
    data,
    column_name
) {
  
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
    !is.data.frame(data) ||
    nrow(data) == 0L ||
    !column_name %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      data[[column_name]][1]
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean harmonised data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_presso_data <- function(
    harmonised_data
) {
  
  required_columns <- c(
    "SNP",
    "beta.exposure",
    "se.exposure",
    "beta.outcome",
    "se.outcome",
    "exposure",
    "outcome",
    "id.exposure",
    "id.outcome"
  )
  
  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(harmonised_data)
  )
  
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }
  
  dat <- as.data.frame(
    harmonised_data
  )
  
  if ("mr_keep" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(
        mr_keep %in% TRUE
      )
  }
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      SNP = as.character(SNP),
      exposure = as.character(exposure),
      outcome = as.character(outcome),
      id.exposure = as.character(id.exposure),
      id.outcome = as.character(id.outcome),
      
      beta.exposure =
        as.numeric(beta.exposure),
      
      se.exposure =
        as.numeric(se.exposure),
      
      beta.outcome =
        as.numeric(beta.outcome),
      
      se.outcome =
        as.numeric(se.outcome)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(SNP),
      SNP != "",
      is.finite(beta.exposure),
      is.finite(se.exposure),
      is.finite(beta.outcome),
      is.finite(se.outcome),
      se.exposure > 0,
      se.outcome > 0
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      id.exposure,
      id.outcome,
      SNP,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
  
  dat
}

# ============================================================
# RUN FULL MR-PRESSO FOR SELECTED PROTEINS
# ============================================================

run_full_mrpresso <- function(
    harmonised_data,
    selected_proteins,
    direction_label,
    nb_distribution = 10000L,
    significance_threshold = 0.05,
    seed = 1234L
) {
  
  dat <- clean_presso_data(
    harmonised_data
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Check selected proteins
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  selected_proteins <- unique(
    as.character(selected_proteins)
  )
  
  selected_proteins <- selected_proteins[
    !is.na(selected_proteins) &
      selected_proteins != ""
  ]
  
  
  if (length(selected_proteins) == 0L) {
    
    message(
      "No proteins were selected for full MR-PRESSO."
    )
    
    return(
      list(
        summary = tibble(),
        outliers = tibble(),
        fits = list(),
        cleaned_input = tibble()
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(
      outcome %in% selected_proteins
    )
  
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0L) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "None of the selected proteins were found ",
        "in the harmonised dataset."
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Split by protein outcome
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  groups <- dat %>%
    group_by(
      id.exposure,
      id.outcome,
      exposure,
      outcome
    ) %>%
    group_split(
      .keep = TRUE
    )
  
  
  summary_results <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(groups)
  )
  
  
  outlier_results <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(groups)
  )
  
  
  complete_fits <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(groups)
  )
  
  
  fit_names <- character(
    length(groups)
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Run each protein separately
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    
    x <- as.data.frame(
      groups[[i]]
    )
    
    
    exposure_name <- as.character(
      x$exposure[1]
    )
    
    
    outcome_name <- as.character(
      x$outcome[1]
    )
    
    
    exposure_id <- as.character(
      x$id.exposure[1]
    )
    
    
    outcome_id <- as.character(
      x$id.outcome[1]
    )
    
    
    nsnp <- nrow(x)
    
    
    fit_names[i] <- paste(
      exposure_name,
      outcome_name,
      sep = "__"
    )
    
    
    cat(
      "\nFull MR-PRESSO ",
      i,
      " of ",
      length(groups),
      ": ",
      exposure_name,
      " -> ",
      outcome_name,
      " | SNPs: ",
      nsnp,
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    
    flush.console()
    
    
    # MR-PRESSO requires at least four instruments
    if (nsnp < 4L) {
      
      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction =
          direction_label,
        
        exposure =
          exposure_name,
        
        outcome =
          outcome_name,
        
        id.exposure =
          exposure_id,
        
        id.outcome =
          outcome_id,
        
        nsnp =
          nsnp,
        
        nb_distribution =
          NA_integer_,
        
        global_RSSobs =
          NA_real_,
        
        global_p_reported =
          NA_character_,
        
        global_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        raw_beta =
          NA_real_,
        
        raw_se =
          NA_real_,
        
        raw_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        corrected_beta =
          NA_real_,
        
        corrected_se =
          NA_real_,
        
        corrected_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        distortion_coefficient =
          NA_real_,
        
        distortion_p_reported =
          NA_character_,
        
        distortion_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        number_of_outliers =
          NA_integer_,
        
        outlier_SNPs =
          NA_character_,
        
        runtime_seconds =
          NA_real_,
        
        runtime_minutes =
          NA_real_,
        
        status =
          "Not run: fewer than four SNPs"
      )
      
      next
    }
    
    
    # Ensure enough simulations for the SNP-level outlier test
    nb_distribution_used <- max(
      as.integer(nb_distribution),
      nsnp + 1L,
      ceiling(
        nsnp / significance_threshold
      ) + 1L
    )
    
    
    # MR-PRESSO keeps row names in its outlier table
    rownames(x) <- make.unique(
      x$SNP
    )
    
    
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    
    fit <- tryCatch(
      {
        MRPRESSO::mr_presso(
          BetaOutcome =
            "beta.outcome",
          
          BetaExposure =
            "beta.exposure",
          
          SdOutcome =
            "se.outcome",
          
          SdExposure =
            "se.exposure",
          
          OUTLIERtest =
            TRUE,
          
          DISTORTIONtest =
            TRUE,
          
          data =
            x,
          
          NbDistribution =
            nb_distribution_used,
          
          SignifThreshold =
            significance_threshold,
          
          seed =
            as.integer(seed + i)
        )
      },
      
      error = function(e) {
        e
      }
    )
    
    
    elapsed_seconds <- as.numeric(
      difftime(
        Sys.time(),
        start_time,
        units = "secs"
      )
    )
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Handle an MR-PRESSO error
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      
      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction =
          direction_label,
        
        exposure =
          exposure_name,
        
        outcome =
          outcome_name,
        
        id.exposure =
          exposure_id,
        
        id.outcome =
          outcome_id,
        
        nsnp =
          nsnp,
        
        nb_distribution =
          nb_distribution_used,
        
        global_RSSobs =
          NA_real_,
        
        global_p_reported =
          NA_character_,
        
        global_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        raw_beta =
          NA_real_,
        
        raw_se =
          NA_real_,
        
        raw_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        corrected_beta =
          NA_real_,
        
        corrected_se =
          NA_real_,
        
        corrected_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        distortion_coefficient =
          NA_real_,
        
        distortion_p_reported =
          NA_character_,
        
        distortion_p =
          NA_real_,
        
        number_of_outliers =
          NA_integer_,
        
        outlier_SNPs =
          NA_character_,
        
        runtime_seconds =
          elapsed_seconds,
        
        runtime_minutes =
          elapsed_seconds / 60,
        
        status = paste(
          "MR-PRESSO error:",
          conditionMessage(fit)
        )
      )
      
      
      cat(
        "Error: ",
        conditionMessage(fit),
        "\n",
        sep = ""
      )
      
      flush.console()
      
      next
    }
    
    
    complete_fits[[i]] <- fit
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract raw and corrected estimates
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    main_results_object <-
      fit[["Main MR results"]]
    
    
    if (is.null(main_results_object)) {
      
      main_results <- data.frame()
      
    } else {
      
      main_results <- as.data.frame(
        main_results_object,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    
    if (
      nrow(main_results) > 0L &&
      "MR Analysis" %in% names(main_results)
    ) {
      
      raw_estimate <- main_results[
        main_results[["MR Analysis"]] == "Raw",
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      
      corrected_estimate <- main_results[
        main_results[["MR Analysis"]] ==
          "Outlier-corrected",
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
    } else {
      
      raw_estimate <- data.frame()
      corrected_estimate <- data.frame()
    }
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract MR-PRESSO components
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    presso_results <-
      fit[["MR-PRESSO results"]]
    
    
    if (is.null(presso_results)) {
      presso_results <- list()
    }
    
    
    global_test <-
      presso_results[["Global Test"]]
    
    
    outlier_test <-
      presso_results[["Outlier Test"]]
    
    
    distortion_test <-
      presso_results[["Distortion Test"]]
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Global test
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    global_rss_raw <- extract_named_value(
      global_test,
      c(
        "RSSobs",
        "RSS"
      )
    )
    
    
    global_p_raw <- extract_named_value(
      global_test,
      c(
        "Pvalue",
        "P-value",
        "P.value"
      )
    )
    
    
    global_p_reported <- if (
      is.null(global_p_raw)
    ) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      as.character(global_p_raw)
    }
    
    
    global_p <- parse_presso_pvalue(
      global_p_reported
    )
    
    
    global_rss <- if (
      is.null(global_rss_raw)
    ) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      as.numeric(global_rss_raw)
    }
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SNP-specific outlier test
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    significant_outlier_snps <-
      character(0)
    
    
    if (
      !is.null(outlier_test) &&
      is.data.frame(outlier_test) &&
      nrow(outlier_test) > 0L
    ) {
      
      outlier_table <- as.data.frame(
        outlier_test,
        check.names = FALSE
      ) %>%
        rownames_to_column(
          var = "SNP"
        ) %>%
        transmute(
          direction =
            direction_label,
          
          exposure =
            exposure_name,
          
          outcome =
            outcome_name,
          
          id.exposure =
            exposure_id,
          
          id.outcome =
            outcome_id,
          
          SNP =
            as.character(SNP),
          
          RSSobs =
            suppressWarnings(
              as.numeric(RSSobs)
            ),
          
          outlier_p_reported =
            as.character(Pvalue),
          
          outlier_p =
            vapply(
              Pvalue,
              parse_presso_pvalue,
              numeric(1)
            ),
          
          significant_outlier =
            !is.na(outlier_p) &
            outlier_p <=
            significance_threshold
        )
      
      
      significant_outlier_snps <-
        outlier_table %>%
        filter(
          significant_outlier %in% TRUE
        ) %>%
        pull(SNP)
      
      
      outlier_results[[i]] <-
        outlier_table
    }
    
    
    number_of_outliers <- length(
      significant_outlier_snps
    )
    
    
    outlier_snp_string <- if (
      number_of_outliers > 0L
    ) {
      
      paste(
        significant_outlier_snps,
        collapse = ";"
      )
      
    } else {
      
      NA_character_
    }
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Distortion test
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    distortion_coefficient_raw <-
      extract_named_value(
        distortion_test,
        c("Distortion Coefficient")
      )
    
    
    distortion_p_raw <-
      extract_named_value(
        distortion_test,
        c(
          "Pvalue",
          "P-value",
          "P.value"
        )
      )
    
    
    distortion_coefficient <- if (
      is.null(distortion_coefficient_raw)
    ) {
      
      NA_real_
      
    } else {
      
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          distortion_coefficient_raw
        )
      )
    }
    
    
    distortion_p_reported <- if (
      is.null(distortion_p_raw)
    ) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      as.character(distortion_p_raw)
    }
    
    
    distortion_p <- parse_presso_pvalue(
      distortion_p_reported
    )
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Analysis status
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    analysis_status <- case_when(
      
      is.na(global_p) ~
        "Completed; global p-value unavailable",
      
      global_p >=
        significance_threshold ~
        paste0(
          "Global test not significant in full run; ",
          "no outliers evaluated"
        ),
      
      number_of_outliers == 0L ~
        paste0(
          "Global test significant, but no ",
          "individual SNP outlier detected"
        ),
      
      !is.na(distortion_p) &&
        distortion_p < significance_threshold ~
        paste0(
          "Outliers detected; removal significantly ",
          "changed the causal estimate"
        ),
      
      number_of_outliers > 0L ~
        paste0(
          "Outliers detected; removal did not ",
          "significantly distort the estimate"
        ),
      
      TRUE ~
        "Completed"
    )
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Main summary row
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
      direction =
        direction_label,
      
      exposure =
        exposure_name,
      
      outcome =
        outcome_name,
      
      id.exposure =
        exposure_id,
      
      id.outcome =
        outcome_id,
      
      nsnp =
        nsnp,
      
      nb_distribution =
        nb_distribution_used,
      
      global_RSSobs =
        global_rss,
      
      global_p_reported =
        global_p_reported,
      
      global_p =
        global_p,
      
      raw_beta =
        extract_table_numeric(
          raw_estimate,
          "Causal Estimate"
        ),
      
      raw_se =
        extract_table_numeric(
          raw_estimate,
          "Sd"
        ),
      
      raw_p =
        extract_table_numeric(
          raw_estimate,
          "P-value"
        ),
      
      corrected_beta =
        extract_table_numeric(
          corrected_estimate,
          "Causal Estimate"
        ),
      
      corrected_se =
        extract_table_numeric(
          corrected_estimate,
          "Sd"
        ),
      
      corrected_p =
        extract_table_numeric(
          corrected_estimate,
          "P-value"
        ),
      
      distortion_coefficient =
        distortion_coefficient,
      
      distortion_p_reported =
        distortion_p_reported,
      
      distortion_p =
        distortion_p,
      
      number_of_outliers =
        number_of_outliers,
      
      outlier_SNPs =
        outlier_snp_string,
      
      runtime_seconds =
        elapsed_seconds,
      
      runtime_minutes =
        elapsed_seconds / 60,
      
      status =
        analysis_status
    )
    
    
    cat(
      "Completed: ",
      outcome_name,
      " | Global p: ",
      global_p_reported,
      " | Outliers: ",
      number_of_outliers,
      " | Time: ",
      round(
        elapsed_seconds / 60,
        2
      ),
      " minutes\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    
    flush.console()
  }
  
  
  names(complete_fits) <- make.unique(
    fit_names
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine outputs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  summary_table <- bind_rows(
    summary_results
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      global_p_FDR =
        p.adjust(
          global_p,
          method = "fdr"
        ),
      
      raw_p_FDR =
        p.adjust(
          raw_p,
          method = "fdr"
        ),
      
      corrected_p_FDR =
        p.adjust(
          corrected_p,
          method = "fdr"
        )
    )
  
  
  outlier_table <- bind_rows(
    outlier_results
  )
  
  
  return(
    list(
      summary =
        summary_table,
      
      outliers =
        outlier_table,
      
      fits =
        complete_fits,
      
      cleaned_input =
        dat
    )
  )
}
```
