```{r}
full_presso_summary_all <- bind_rows(
  full_presso_creat$summary,
  full_presso_cys$summary
) %>%
  mutate(
    global_p_FDR_all =
      p.adjust(
        global_p,
        method = "fdr"
      ),
    
    raw_p_FDR_all =
      p.adjust(
        raw_p,
        method = "fdr"
      ),
    
    corrected_p_FDR_all =
      p.adjust(
        corrected_p,
        method = "fdr"
      )
  )


full_presso_outliers_all <- bind_rows(
  full_presso_creat$outliers,
  full_presso_cys$outliers
)


print(
  full_presso_summary_all,
  n = Inf
)
```




#running sensitivity analysis using MR PREESSO for significant protein 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# COMPLETE MR-PRESSO ANALYSIS
# Reverse MR:
#   eGFRcrea -> circulating proteins
#   eGFRcys  -> circulating proteins
#
# Required existing objects:
#   dat_reverse_creat
#   dat_reverse_cys
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# 15. MR-PRESSO sensitivity analysis for reverse MR
# ============================================================

# Install MR-PRESSO if it is not already installed
if (!requireNamespace("MRPRESSO", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("remotes")
  }

  remotes::install_github("rondolab/MR-PRESSO")
}

library(MRPRESSO)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: convert MR-PRESSO p-values to numeric
#
# MR-PRESSO sometimes reports p-values as character strings,
# for example "<0.0001". This function converts such values
# to numeric values for filtering and FDR correction.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_presso_pvalue <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)

  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      sub("^<\\s*", "", x)
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: safely extract one numeric value
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_numeric <- function(data, column_name) {

  if (
    is.null(data) ||
    nrow(data) == 0 ||
    !column_name %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(data[[column_name]][1])
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Main function
#
# Runs MR-PRESSO separately for every exposure-outcome pair.
# In your analysis this means separately for each protein.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_mrpresso_by_outcome <- function(
    harmonised_data,
    direction_label,
    nb_distribution = 10000L,
    significance_threshold = 0.05,
    seed = 1234L
) {

  required_columns <- c(
    "SNP",
    "beta.exposure",
    "se.exposure",
    "beta.outcome",
    "se.outcome",
    "exposure",
    "outcome",
    "id.exposure",
    "id.outcome"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(harmonised_data)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required columns are missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  dat <- harmonised_data

  # Retain SNPs marked for MR analysis
  if ("mr_keep" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(mr_keep == TRUE)
  }

  # Remove incomplete rows and duplicate SNPs within each analysis
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(
      complete.cases(
        beta.exposure,
        se.exposure,
        beta.outcome,
        se.outcome
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      id.exposure,
      id.outcome,
      SNP,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    stop("No complete harmonised SNPs were available for MR-PRESSO.")
  }

  # Split into separate exposure-outcome analyses
  analysis_groups <- dat %>%
    group_by(
      id.exposure,
      id.outcome,
      exposure,
      outcome
    ) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE)

  summary_results <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(analysis_groups)
  )

  outlier_results <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(analysis_groups)
  )

  raw_results <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(analysis_groups)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(analysis_groups)) {

    x <- as.data.frame(analysis_groups[[i]])

    exposure_name <- as.character(x$exposure[1])
    outcome_name <- as.character(x$outcome[1])

    exposure_id <- as.character(x$id.exposure[1])
    outcome_id <- as.character(x$id.outcome[1])

    number_of_snps <- nrow(x)

    cat(
      "\nRunning MR-PRESSO:",
      exposure_name,
      "→",
      outcome_name,
      "| SNPs:",
      number_of_snps,
      "\n"
    )

    # MR-PRESSO requires more than three instruments for
    # univariable MR.
    if (number_of_snps < 4) {

      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction = direction_label,
        exposure = exposure_name,
        outcome = outcome_name,
        id.exposure = exposure_id,
        id.outcome = outcome_id,
        nsnp = number_of_snps,
        nb_distribution = NA_integer_,
        global_RSSobs = NA_real_,
        global_p = NA_real_,
        raw_beta = NA_real_,
        raw_se = NA_real_,
        raw_p = NA_real_,
        corrected_beta = NA_real_,
        corrected_se = NA_real_,
        corrected_p = NA_real_,
        distortion_coefficient = NA_real_,
        distortion_p = NA_real_,
        number_of_outliers = NA_integer_,
        outlier_SNPs = NA_character_,
        status = "MR-PRESSO not run: fewer than four SNPs"
      )

      next
    }

    # NbDistribution must be larger than the number of SNPs.
    # It must also be sufficiently large for the requested
    # outlier-test significance threshold.
    nb_distribution_used <- max(
      as.integer(nb_distribution),
      number_of_snps + 1L,
      ceiling(number_of_snps / significance_threshold) + 1L
    )

    # MR-PRESSO preserves row names in the outlier table.
    # Using SNP names here allows direct SNP identification.
    rownames(x) <- x$SNP

    fit <- tryCatch(
      {
        MRPRESSO::mr_presso(
          BetaOutcome = "beta.outcome",
          BetaExposure = "beta.exposure",
          SdOutcome = "se.outcome",
          SdExposure = "se.exposure",
          OUTLIERtest = TRUE,
          DISTORTIONtest = TRUE,
          data = x,
          NbDistribution = nb_distribution_used,
          SignifThreshold = significance_threshold,
          seed = seed + i
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        e
      }
    )

    # Record errors without stopping the remaining proteins
    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {

      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction = direction_label,
        exposure = exposure_name,
        outcome = outcome_name,
        id.exposure = exposure_id,
        id.outcome = outcome_id,
        nsnp = number_of_snps,
        nb_distribution = nb_distribution_used,
        global_RSSobs = NA_real_,
        global_p = NA_real_,
        raw_beta = NA_real_,
        raw_se = NA_real_,
        raw_p = NA_real_,
        corrected_beta = NA_real_,
        corrected_se = NA_real_,
        corrected_p = NA_real_,
        distortion_coefficient = NA_real_,
        distortion_p = NA_real_,
        number_of_outliers = NA_integer_,
        outlier_SNPs = NA_character_,
        status = paste(
          "MR-PRESSO error:",
          conditionMessage(fit)
        )
      )

      next
    }

    raw_results[[i]] <- fit

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract raw and outlier-corrected MR estimates
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    main_results <- as.data.frame(
      fit[["Main MR results"]],
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    raw_estimate <- main_results[
      main_results[["MR Analysis"]] == "Raw",
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    corrected_estimate <- main_results[
      main_results[["MR Analysis"]] == "Outlier-corrected",
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract global pleiotropy test
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    presso_results <- fit[["MR-PRESSO results"]]

    global_test <- presso_results[["Global Test"]]

    global_rss <- if (!is.null(global_test)) {
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(global_test[["RSSobs"]][1])
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    global_p_text <- if (!is.null(global_test)) {
      global_test[["Pvalue"]][1]
    } else {
      NA
    }

    global_p <- parse_presso_pvalue(global_p_text)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract SNP-specific outlier test
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    outlier_test <- presso_results[["Outlier Test"]]

    significant_outlier_snps <- character(0)

    if (!is.null(outlier_test)) {

      outlier_table <- as.data.frame(
        outlier_test,
        check.names = FALSE
      ) %>%
        rownames_to_column("SNP") %>%
        transmute(
          direction = direction_label,
          exposure = exposure_name,
          outcome = outcome_name,
          id.exposure = exposure_id,
          id.outcome = outcome_id,
          SNP = as.character(SNP),
          RSSobs = suppressWarnings(
            as.numeric(RSSobs)
          ),
          outlier_p_reported = as.character(Pvalue),
          outlier_p = parse_presso_pvalue(Pvalue),
          significant_outlier =
            !is.na(outlier_p) &
            outlier_p <= significance_threshold
        )

      significant_outlier_snps <- outlier_table %>%
        filter(significant_outlier == TRUE) %>%
        pull(SNP)

      outlier_results[[i]] <- outlier_table
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract distortion test
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    distortion_test <- presso_results[["Distortion Test"]]

    distortion_coefficient <- NA_real_
    distortion_p <- NA_real_

    if (!is.null(distortion_test)) {

      if (
        !is.null(
          distortion_test[["Distortion Coefficient"]]
        )
      ) {
        distortion_coefficient <- suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(
            distortion_test[
              ["Distortion Coefficient"]
            ][1]
          )
        )
      }

      if (!is.null(distortion_test[["Pvalue"]])) {
        distortion_p <- parse_presso_pvalue(
          distortion_test[["Pvalue"]][1]
        )
      }
    }

    number_of_outliers <- length(
      significant_outlier_snps
    )

    outlier_snp_string <- if (
      number_of_outliers > 0
    ) {
      paste(
        significant_outlier_snps,
        collapse = ";"
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }

    analysis_status <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(global_p) ~
        "Completed; global p-value unavailable",

      global_p >= significance_threshold ~
        paste0(
          "Global test not significant; ",
          "no outlier correction required"
        ),

      number_of_outliers == 0 ~
        paste0(
          "Global test significant, but no individual ",
          "outlier passed the corrected threshold"
        ),

      TRUE ~
        "Outlier SNPs detected; corrected estimate available"
    )

    summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
      direction = direction_label,
      exposure = exposure_name,
      outcome = outcome_name,
      id.exposure = exposure_id,
      id.outcome = outcome_id,
      nsnp = number_of_snps,
      nb_distribution = nb_distribution_used,

      global_RSSobs = global_rss,
      global_p = global_p,

      raw_beta = extract_numeric(
        raw_estimate,
        "Causal Estimate"
      ),
      raw_se = extract_numeric(
        raw_estimate,
        "Sd"
      ),
      raw_p = extract_numeric(
        raw_estimate,
        "P-value"
      ),

      corrected_beta = extract_numeric(
        corrected_estimate,
        "Causal Estimate"
      ),
      corrected_se = extract_numeric(
        corrected_estimate,
        "Sd"
      ),
      corrected_p = extract_numeric(
        corrected_estimate,
        "P-value"
      ),

      distortion_coefficient =
        distortion_coefficient,

      distortion_p = distortion_p,

      number_of_outliers =
        number_of_outliers,

      outlier_SNPs =
        outlier_snp_string,

      status = analysis_status
    )
  }

  summary_table <- bind_rows(summary_results) %>%
    group_by(direction) %>%
    mutate(
      global_p_FDR = p.adjust(
        global_p,
        method = "fdr"
      ),
      raw_p_FDR = p.adjust(
        raw_p,
        method = "fdr"
      ),
      corrected_p_FDR = p.adjust(
        corrected_p,
        method = "fdr"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  outlier_table <- bind_rows(outlier_results)

  analysis_names <- vapply(
    analysis_groups,
    function(x) {
      paste(
        as.character(x$exposure[1]),
        as.character(x$outcome[1]),
        sep = "__"
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )

  names(raw_results) <- analysis_names

  return(
    list(
      summary = summary_table,
      outliers = outlier_table,
      raw_results = raw_results
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 16. Run MR-PRESSO
# ============================================================

set.seed(1234)

presso_reverse_creat <- run_mrpresso_by_outcome(
  harmonised_data = dat_reverse_creat,
  direction_label = "eGFRcrea→Protein",
  nb_distribution = 10000,
  significance_threshold = 0.05,
  seed = 1234
)

presso_reverse_cys <- run_mrpresso_by_outcome(
  harmonised_data = dat_reverse_cys,
  direction_label = "eGFRcys→Protein",
  nb_distribution = 10000,
  significance_threshold = 0.05,
  seed = 5678
)

# ============================================================
# 17. Combine MR-PRESSO results
# ============================================================

presso_summary_all <- bind_rows(
  presso_reverse_creat$summary,
  presso_reverse_cys$summary
)

presso_outliers_all <- bind_rows(
  presso_reverse_creat$outliers,
  presso_reverse_cys$outliers
)

# Main summary
print(
  presso_summary_all %>%
    select(
      direction,
      outcome,
      nsnp,
      global_p,
      global_p_FDR,
      number_of_outliers,
      raw_beta,
      raw_se,
      raw_p,
      corrected_beta,
      corrected_se,
      corrected_p,
      distortion_coefficient,
      distortion_p,
      outlier_SNPs,
      status
    )
)

# Only analyses with significant global pleiotropy
presso_summary_all %>%
  filter(global_p < 0.05)

# Only significant outlier SNPs
presso_outliers_all %>%
  filter(significant_outlier == TRUE)

# ============================================================
# 18. Save MR-PRESSO results
# ============================================================

dir.create(
  "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  presso_reverse_creat$summary,
  paste0(
    "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
    "MRPRESSO_reverse_eGFRcrea_to_protein_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  presso_reverse_cys$summary,
  paste0(
    "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
    "MRPRESSO_reverse_eGFRcys_to_protein_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  presso_summary_all,
  paste0(
    "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
    "MRPRESSO_reverse_all_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if (nrow(presso_reverse_creat$outliers) > 0) {
  write.csv(
    presso_reverse_creat$outliers,
    paste0(
      "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
      "MRPRESSO_reverse_eGFRcrea_outlier_tests.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

if (nrow(presso_reverse_cys$outliers) > 0) {
  write.csv(
    presso_reverse_cys$outliers,
    paste0(
      "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
      "MRPRESSO_reverse_eGFRcys_outlier_tests.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

if (nrow(presso_outliers_all) > 0) {
  write.csv(
    presso_outliers_all,
    paste0(
      "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
      "MRPRESSO_reverse_all_outlier_tests.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

# Preserve the complete nested MR-PRESSO output
saveRDS(
  presso_reverse_creat,
  paste0(
    "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
    "MRPRESSO_reverse_eGFRcrea_complete.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  presso_reverse_cys,
  paste0(
    "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO/",
    "MRPRESSO_reverse_eGFRcys_complete.rds"
  )
)
```




#Full code in one chunck
```{r}
# ============================================================
# REVERSE MR: eGFR → PROTEIN
# (Testing if kidney function affects protein levels)
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# REVERSE MR: eGFR → PROTEIN
# (Testing if kidney function affects protein levels)
# ============================================================

# Load required libraries
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(ieugwasr)

set.seed(1234)

# ============================================================
# 1. Candidate proteins from your mass-spec analysis
# ============================================================

candidate_proteins <- tribble(
  ~protein_full_name, ~overlap, ~uniprot_id, ~Gene,
  "Complement factor D", "CFAD", "K7ERG9", "CFD",
  "Retinol-binding protein 4", "RBP4", "Q5VY30", "RBP4",
  "Pigment epithelium-derived factor", "PEDF", "P36955", "SERPINF1",
  "Beta-2-microglobulin", "B2M", "P61769", "B2M",
  "Zinc-alpha-2-glycoprotein", "ZA2G", "P25311", "AZGP1",
  "Prostaglandin-H2 D-isomerase", "PTGDS", "P41222", "PTGDS",
  "Glutathione peroxidase 3", "GPX3", "P22352", "GPX3",
  "Rhox homeobox family member 1", "RHXF1", "Q8NHV9", "RHOXF1",
  "Transferrin receptor protein 1", "TFR1", "G3V0E5", "TFRC",
  "Leucine-rich repeat transmembrane neuronal protein 2", "LRRT2", "O43300", "LRRTM2"
)

# Check the data
head(candidate_proteins)
names(candidate_proteins)

candidate_genes <- unique(candidate_proteins$Gene)

# ============================================================
# 2. File paths for deCODE pQTL data (used as outcome in reverse MR)
# ============================================================

pqtl_dir <- mr_data_dir

# List all pQTL files
pqtl_files <- list.files(
  pqtl_dir,
  pattern = "\\.txt\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Remove empty files
file_info <- file.info(pqtl_files)
pqtl_files <- rownames(file_info)[file_info$size > 1e6]

# Keep only files matching your candidate genes
pqtl_files <- pqtl_files[
  str_detect(
    basename(pqtl_files),
    paste(candidate_genes, collapse = "|")
  )
]

print(basename(pqtl_files))

# ============================================================
# 3. Read and combine deCODE pQTL data
# ============================================================

pqtl_list <- list()

for (file in pqtl_files) {
  
  temp_pqtl <- fread(file)
  
  gene_name <- str_extract(
    basename(file),
    paste(candidate_genes, collapse = "|")
  )
  
  assay_id <- sub("\\.txt\\.gz$", "", basename(file))
  
  temp_pqtl$gene_name <- gene_name
  temp_pqtl$assay_id <- assay_id
  
  pqtl_list[[assay_id]] <- temp_pqtl
}

decode_pqtl <- rbindlist(pqtl_list, fill = TRUE)

head(decode_pqtl)
names(decode_pqtl)

# Save for later
#save(decode_pqtl, file = file.path(mr_data_dir, "decode_pqtl.RData"))

load(file.path(mr_data_dir, "decode_pqtl.RData"))

# ============================================================
# 4. Standardise deCODE pQTL columns (used as outcome in reverse MR)
# ============================================================

decode_std <- decode_pqtl %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene_name,
    chr = as.character(Chrom),
    pos = as.integer(Pos),
    variant_id = as.character(Name),
    rsid = sub("[,;].*$", "", as.character(rsids)),
    beta = as.numeric(Beta),
    se = as.numeric(SE),
    pval = as.numeric(Pval),
    effect_allele = toupper(as.character(effectAllele)),
    other_allele = toupper(as.character(otherAllele)),
    maf = as.numeric(ImpMAF),
    n = as.numeric(N)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(rsid),
    rsid != "",
    rsid != ".",
    str_detect(rsid, "^rs"),
    !is.na(beta),
    !is.na(se),
    !is.na(Pval),
    effect_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T"),
    other_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T")
  )

head(decode_std)
names(decode_std)

# ============================================================
# 5. Keep pQTLs for your candidate proteins (outcomes)
# ============================================================

pqtl_candidates <- decode_std

# If cis/trans annotation exists, filter for cis
if ("cis_trans" %in% names(pqtl_candidates)) {
  pqtl_candidates <- pqtl_candidates %>%
    filter(cis_trans == "cis")
}

cat("\n=== SNPs per gene before significance filtering ===\n")
print(table(pqtl_candidates$gene))

# ============================================================
# 6. Select strong pQTL instruments (for reverse MR, these are OUTCOMES)
# ============================================================

pqtl_sig <- pqtl_candidates %>%
  filter(pval < 5e-8)

#write.csv(pqtl_sig, file = "pqtl_sig.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== Significant SNPs per gene (p < 5e-8) ===\n")
print(table(pqtl_sig$gene))

# Check if any genes have instruments
if (nrow(pqtl_sig) == 0) {
  stop("No significant pQTLs found for any candidate gene!")
}

# Check which genes have at least one instrument
genes_with_instruments <- unique(pqtl_sig$gene)
cat("\nGenes with significant instruments:", 
    paste(genes_with_instruments, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Save pqtl_sig for later use as outcome data
fwrite(pqtl_sig, "pqtl_sig_reverse.csv")

# ============================================================
# 7. READ eGFR GWAS AS EXPOSURE (This is the key change for reverse MR)
# ============================================================

egfr_creat_file <- file.path(mr_data_dir, "metal_eGFR_meta_ea1.TBL.map.annot.gc.gz")
egfr_cys_file <- file.path(mr_data_dir, "metal_eGFRcys_meta1.TBL.map.annot.gc.gz")

if (!file.exists(egfr_creat_file)) stop("Creatinine eGFR file not found!")
if (!file.exists(egfr_cys_file)) stop("Cystatin-C eGFR file not found!")

# Read GWAS data
egfr_creat <- fread(egfr_creat_file)
egfr_cys <- fread(egfr_cys_file)

# Check column names
cat("\n=== Column names in Creatinine eGFR data ===\n")
print(names(egfr_creat)[1:10])

cat("\n=== Column names in Cystatin-C eGFR data ===\n")
print(names(egfr_cys)[1:10])

# ============================================================
# 8. Extract instruments from eGFR GWAS (exposure in reverse MR)
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# 8. Extract eGFR instruments
# ============================================================

extract_egfr_instruments <- function(gwas_data, p_threshold = 5e-8) {
  gwas_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(P.value), P.value < p_threshold) %>%
    transmute(
      rsid = as.character(RSID),
      beta = as.numeric(Effect),
      se = as.numeric(StdErr),
      effect_allele = toupper(as.character(Allele1)),
      other_allele = toupper(as.character(Allele2)),
      eaf = as.numeric(Freq1),
      pval = as.numeric(P.value),
      samplesize = as.numeric(n),
      chr = as.character(chr),
      pos = as.integer(pos)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(rsid),
      rsid != "",
      rsid != ".",
      str_detect(rsid, "^rs"),
      !is.na(beta),
      !is.na(se),
      !is.na(pval),
      effect_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T"),
      other_allele %in% c("A", "C", "G", "T")
    )
}

egfr_creat_instruments <- extract_egfr_instruments(egfr_creat)
egfr_cys_instruments <- extract_egfr_instruments(egfr_cys)

format_egfr_exposure <- function(egfr_data, exposure_name) {
  
  exposure_dat <- format_data(
    as.data.frame(egfr_data),
    type = "exposure",
    snp_col = "rsid",
    beta_col = "beta",
    se_col = "se",
    effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",
    other_allele_col = "other_allele",
    eaf_col = "eaf",
    pval_col = "pval",
    samplesize_col = "samplesize",
    phenotype_col = "RSID"
  )
  
  exposure_dat$exposure <- exposure_name
  exposure_dat$id.exposure <- exposure_name
  
  return(exposure_dat)
}

prepare_pqtl_outcome <- function(pqtl_data, exposure_snps, gene_list) {
  
  outcome_data <- pqtl_data %>%
    filter(
      rsid %in% exposure_snps,
      gene %in% gene_list
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      SNP = rsid,
      beta.outcome = beta,
      se.outcome = se,
      effect_allele.outcome = effect_allele,
      other_allele.outcome = other_allele,
      pval.outcome = pval,
      samplesize.outcome = n,
      outcome = gene,
      id.outcome = gene
    )
  
  return(outcome_data)
}

# ============================================================
# 10. Run reverse MR
# ============================================================

run_reverse_mr <- function(harmonise_data, direction_label) {
  if (is.null(harmonise_data) || nrow(harmonise_data) == 0) {
    cat("⚠️ No SNPs available for", direction_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("\nRunning reverse MR for:", direction_label, "\n")
  
  mr_results <- mr(
    harmonise_data,
    method_list = c(
      "mr_wald_ratio",
      "mr_ivw",
      "mr_weighted_median",
      "mr_egger_regression"
    )
  )
  
  mr_results <- mr_results %>%
    group_by(outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      p_FDR = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"),
      p_Bonferroni = p.adjust(pval, method = "bonferroni")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  mr_results$direction <- direction_label
  
  heterogeneity <- tryCatch(mr_heterogeneity(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  pleiotropy <- tryCatch(mr_pleiotropy_test(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  leaveoneout <- tryCatch(mr_leaveoneout(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  single_snp <- tryCatch(mr_singlesnp(harmonise_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  return(list(
    mr_results = mr_results,
    heterogeneity = heterogeneity,
    pleiotropy = pleiotropy,
    leaveoneout = leaveoneout,
    single_snp = single_snp,
    harmonised_data = harmonise_data
  ))
}

# Run reverse MR

print_mr_plot <- function(plot_object) {
  if (is.null(plot_object)) return(NULL)
  
  if (is.list(plot_object)) {
    invisible(lapply(plot_object, print))
  } else {
    print(plot_object)
  }
}

plot_reverse_mr_results <- function(results,
                                    outcome_label,
                                    save_pdf = TRUE,
                                    pdf_dir = "MR_plots_reverse",
                                    width = 12,
                                    height = 10,
                                    include_scatter = TRUE,
                                    include_combined = TRUE,
                                    print_plots = TRUE) {
  
  if (is.null(results) || is.null(results$mr_results) || nrow(results$mr_results) == 0) {
    cat("No MR results to plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.null(results$harmonised_data) || nrow(results$harmonised_data) == 0) {
    cat("No harmonised data to plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (save_pdf && !dir.exists(pdf_dir)) {
    dir.create(pdf_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
    cat("✓ Created directory:", pdf_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  all_plots <- list()
  
  # Single-SNP data
  single_snp <- tryCatch(
    mr_singlesnp(results$harmonised_data),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Single-SNP analysis failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  # ============================================================
  # 1. Forest plot
  # ============================================================
  
  if (!is.null(single_snp) && nrow(single_snp) > 0) {
    
    cat("\n✓ Generating Forest Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    
    forest_plot <- tryCatch(
      mr_forest_plot(single_snp),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Forest plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    all_plots$forest <- forest_plot
    
    if (print_plots) print_mr_plot(forest_plot)
    
    if (save_pdf && !is.null(forest_plot)) {
      pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("1_forest_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
      pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
      print_mr_plot(forest_plot)
      dev.off()
      cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 2. Funnel plot
  # ============================================================
  
  if (!is.null(single_snp) && nrow(single_snp) > 0) {
    
    cat("✓ Generating Funnel Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    
    funnel_plot <- tryCatch(
      mr_funnel_plot(single_snp),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Funnel plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    all_plots$funnel <- funnel_plot
    
    if (print_plots) print_mr_plot(funnel_plot)
    
    if (save_pdf && !is.null(funnel_plot)) {
      pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("2_funnel_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
      pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
      print_mr_plot(funnel_plot)
      dev.off()
      cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 3. Leave-one-out plot
  # ============================================================
  
  loo_plot <- NULL
  
  if (!is.null(results$leaveoneout) && nrow(results$leaveoneout) > 0) {
    
    cat("✓ Generating Leave-One-Out Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    
    loo_plot <- tryCatch(
      mr_leaveoneout_plot(results$leaveoneout),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Leave-one-out plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    all_plots$loo <- loo_plot
    
    if (print_plots) print_mr_plot(loo_plot)
    
    if (save_pdf && !is.null(loo_plot)) {
      pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("3_leaveoneout_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
      pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
      print_mr_plot(loo_plot)
      dev.off()
      cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Leave-one-out plot skipped for", outcome_label, "\n")
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 4. Scatter plot
  # ============================================================
  
  scatter_plot <- NULL
  
  if (include_scatter) {
    
    cat("✓ Generating Scatter Plot for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    
    scatter_plot <- tryCatch(
      mr_scatter_plot(
        mr_results = results$mr_results,
        dat = results$harmonised_data
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Scatter plot failed:", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    all_plots$scatter <- scatter_plot
    
    if (print_plots) print_mr_plot(scatter_plot)
    
    if (save_pdf && !is.null(scatter_plot)) {
      pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("4_scatter_plot_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
      pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height)
      print_mr_plot(scatter_plot)
      dev.off()
      cat("  → Saved:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # ============================================================
  # 5. Combined PDF
  # ============================================================
  
  if (save_pdf && include_combined) {
    
    cat("✓ Generating Combined PDF for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    
    combined_pdf <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0("ALL_plots_combined_", outcome_label, ".pdf"))
    pdf(combined_pdf, width = width, height = height)
    
    plot.new()
    text(0.5, 0.7, "MENDELIAN RANDOMIZATION ANALYSIS", cex = 2.2, font = 2)
    text(0.5, 0.6, "eGFR → Protein (Reverse MR)", cex = 1.8, font = 2)
    text(0.5, 0.48, outcome_label, cex = 1.4)
    text(0.5, 0.4, paste("Analysis Date:", Sys.Date()), cex = 1.2)
    text(0.5, 0.35, paste("Harmonised SNP-protein rows:", nrow(results$harmonised_data)), cex = 1.2)
    
    ivw_results <- results$mr_results %>%
      filter(method == "Inverse variance weighted")
    
    if (nrow(ivw_results) > 0) {
      text(0.5, 0.25, paste("First IVW Beta:", round(ivw_results$b[1], 4)), cex = 1.1)
      text(0.5, 0.2, paste("First IVW P-value:", format(ivw_results$pval[1], scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)), cex = 1.1)
    }
    
    if (exists("forest_plot") && !is.null(forest_plot)) print_mr_plot(forest_plot)
    if (exists("funnel_plot") && !is.null(funnel_plot)) print_mr_plot(funnel_plot)
    if (!is.null(loo_plot)) print_mr_plot(loo_plot)
    if (!is.null(scatter_plot)) print_mr_plot(scatter_plot)
    
    dev.off()
    cat("  → Saved:", basename(combined_pdf), "\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n✓ All plots completed for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  
  invisible(all_plots)
}


# ============================================================
# Generate and save reverse MR plots
# ============================================================

cat("\n========== GENERATING REVERSE MR PLOTS ==========\n")

plots_dir <- "MR_plots_reverse"

cat("\n", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep = "")
cat("GENERATING PLOTS: eGFRcrea → Protein")
cat("\n", rep("=", 50), "\n", sep = "")

plot_reverse_mr_results(

plot_reverse_mr_results(

# ============================================================
# 16. Summary comparison table with cross-outcome FDR
# ============================================================

compare_reverse_results <- function(creat_results, cys_results) {
  
  creat_sig <- tibble()
  cys_sig <- tibble()
  
  if (!is.null(creat_results) && !is.null(creat_results$mr_results)) {
    creat_sig <- creat_results$mr_results %>%
      filter(pval < 0.05) %>%
      select(exposure, outcome, method, nsnp, b, se, pval, p_FDR, p_Bonferroni, direction)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cys_results) && !is.null(cys_results$mr_results)) {
    cys_sig <- cys_results$mr_results %>%
      filter(pval < 0.05) %>%
      select(exposure, outcome, method, nsnp, b, se, pval, p_FDR, p_Bonferroni, direction)
  }
  
  cat("\n=== Nominally significant reverse MR results: eGFRcrea → Protein ===\n")
  if (nrow(creat_sig) > 0) {
    print(creat_sig)
  } else {
    cat("No nominally significant results found\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n=== Nominally significant reverse MR results: eGFRcys → Protein ===\n")
  if (nrow(cys_sig) > 0) {
    print(cys_sig)
  } else {
    cat("No nominally significant results found\n")
  }
  
  combined <- bind_rows(
    mutate(creat_sig, outcome_type = "Creatinine"),
    mutate(cys_sig, outcome_type = "Cystatin-C")
  )
  
  if (nrow(combined) > 0) {
    combined <- combined %>%
      mutate(
        cross_outcome_FDR = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"),
        cross_outcome_Bonferroni = p.adjust(pval, method = "bonferroni")
      )
  }
  
  write.csv(
    combined,
    "MR_results_reverse/reverse_MR_significant_results_comparison.csv",
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  return(combined)
}

comparison_table_reverse <- compare_reverse_results(reverse_creat, reverse_cys)

cat("\n========== REVERSE MR ANALYSIS COMPLETE ==========\n")
```


#MR PRESSO revised code 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# COMPLETE REVISED MR-PRESSO SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# Reverse MR:
#   eGFRcrea -> circulating proteins
#   eGFRcys  -> circulating proteins
#
# REQUIRED EXISTING OBJECTS:
#   dat_reverse_creat
#   dat_reverse_cys
#
# Run this script AFTER LD clumping and harmonisation.
# You do not need to repeat the full MR pipeline.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. Install and load packages
# ============================================================

if (!requireNamespace("MRPRESSO", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("remotes")
  }
  remotes::install_github("rondolab/MR-PRESSO")
}

required_packages <- c("MRPRESSO", "dplyr", "tibble")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The following packages are unavailable: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

library(MRPRESSO)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


# ============================================================
# 2. Helper functions
# ============================================================

# Convert MR-PRESSO values such as "<0.0001" to numeric 0.0001.
# The original reported string is retained separately in the results.
parse_presso_pvalue <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) {
    return(numeric(0))
  }
  
  x_character <- trimws(as.character(x))
  output <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(sub("^<\\s*", "", x_character))
  )
  output[is.na(x_character)] <- NA_real_
  output
}


# Safely extract the first named value from a list.
extract_named_value <- function(x, value_name) {
  if (
    is.null(x) ||
    is.null(names(x)) ||
    !value_name %in% names(x) ||
    length(x[[value_name]]) == 0L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  x[[value_name]][1]
}


# Safely extract a numeric value from a named list component.
extract_named_numeric <- function(x, value_name) {
  value <- extract_named_value(x, value_name)
  
  if (is.null(value)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
}


# Safely extract a character value from a named list component.
extract_named_character <- function(x, value_name) {
  value <- extract_named_value(x, value_name)
  
  if (is.null(value)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  as.character(value)
}


# Safely extract the first numeric value from a data-frame column.
extract_table_numeric <- function(data, column_name) {
  if (
    is.null(data) ||
    !is.data.frame(data) ||
    nrow(data) == 0L ||
    !column_name %in% names(data)
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data[[column_name]][1]))
}


# Create an empty, consistently structured outlier table.
empty_outlier_table <- function() {
  tibble(
    direction = character(),
    exposure = character(),
    outcome = character(),
    id.exposure = character(),
    id.outcome = character(),
    SNP = character(),
    RSSobs = numeric(),
    outlier_p_reported = character(),
    outlier_p = numeric(),
    significant_outlier = logical()
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Main function: run MR-PRESSO separately for each protein
# ============================================================

run_mrpresso_by_outcome <- function(
    harmonised_data,
    direction_label,
    nb_distribution = 10000L,
    significance_threshold = 0.05,
    seed = 1234L
) {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Validate inputs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (is.null(harmonised_data)) {
    stop("harmonised_data is NULL.")
  }
  
  harmonised_data <- as.data.frame(harmonised_data)
  
  if (nrow(harmonised_data) == 0L) {
    stop("harmonised_data contains no rows.")
  }
  
  if (
    !is.numeric(significance_threshold) ||
    length(significance_threshold) != 1L ||
    is.na(significance_threshold) ||
    significance_threshold <= 0 ||
    significance_threshold >= 1
  ) {
    stop("significance_threshold must be a number between 0 and 1.")
  }
  
  if (
    !is.numeric(nb_distribution) ||
    length(nb_distribution) != 1L ||
    is.na(nb_distribution) ||
    nb_distribution < 1
  ) {
    stop("nb_distribution must be a positive integer.")
  }
  
  required_columns <- c(
    "SNP",
    "beta.exposure",
    "se.exposure",
    "beta.outcome",
    "se.outcome",
    "exposure",
    "outcome",
    "id.exposure",
    "id.outcome"
  )
  
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(harmonised_data))
  
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The following required columns are missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Clean harmonised data
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  dat <- harmonised_data
  
  if ("mr_keep" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(mr_keep %in% TRUE)
  }
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      SNP = as.character(SNP),
      beta.exposure = as.numeric(beta.exposure),
      se.exposure = as.numeric(se.exposure),
      beta.outcome = as.numeric(beta.outcome),
      se.outcome = as.numeric(se.outcome),
      exposure = as.character(exposure),
      outcome = as.character(outcome),
      id.exposure = as.character(id.exposure),
      id.outcome = as.character(id.outcome)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(SNP),
      SNP != "",
      is.finite(beta.exposure),
      is.finite(se.exposure),
      is.finite(beta.outcome),
      is.finite(se.outcome),
      se.exposure > 0,
      se.outcome > 0
    ) %>%
    distinct(id.exposure, id.outcome, SNP, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0L) {
    stop("No valid harmonised SNPs remained after data cleaning.")
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Split into separate exposure-outcome analyses
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  analysis_groups <- dat %>%
    group_by(id.exposure, id.outcome, exposure, outcome) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE)
  
  summary_results <- vector("list", length(analysis_groups))
  outlier_results <- vector("list", length(analysis_groups))
  raw_results <- vector("list", length(analysis_groups))
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Run MR-PRESSO for each protein
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  for (i in seq_along(analysis_groups)) {
    
    x <- as.data.frame(analysis_groups[[i]])
    
    exposure_name <- as.character(x$exposure[1])
    outcome_name <- as.character(x$outcome[1])
    exposure_id <- as.character(x$id.exposure[1])
    outcome_id <- as.character(x$id.outcome[1])
    number_of_snps <- nrow(x)
    
    cat(
      "\nRunning MR-PRESSO:",
      exposure_name,
      "->",
      outcome_name,
      "| SNPs:",
      number_of_snps,
      "\n"
    )
    
    
    # MR-PRESSO requires at least four SNPs in univariable MR.
    if (number_of_snps < 4L) {
      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction = direction_label,
        exposure = exposure_name,
        outcome = outcome_name,
        id.exposure = exposure_id,
        id.outcome = outcome_id,
        nsnp = number_of_snps,
        nb_distribution = NA_integer_,
        global_RSSobs = NA_real_,
        global_p_reported = NA_character_,
        global_p = NA_real_,
        raw_beta = NA_real_,
        raw_se = NA_real_,
        raw_p = NA_real_,
        corrected_beta = NA_real_,
        corrected_se = NA_real_,
        corrected_p = NA_real_,
        distortion_coefficient = NA_real_,
        distortion_p_reported = NA_character_,
        distortion_p = NA_real_,
        number_of_outliers = NA_integer_,
        outlier_SNPs = NA_character_,
        status = "MR-PRESSO not run: fewer than four SNPs"
      )
      
      outlier_results[[i]] <- empty_outlier_table()
      next
    }
    
    
    # Ensure enough simulations for the number of instruments and
    # the requested SNP-specific outlier significance threshold.
    nb_distribution_used <- max(
      as.integer(nb_distribution),
      number_of_snps + 1L,
      ceiling(number_of_snps / significance_threshold) + 1L
    )
    
    # MR-PRESSO uses input row names in its outlier output.
    rownames(x) <- x$SNP
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Run MR-PRESSO
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    fit <- tryCatch(
      MRPRESSO::mr_presso(
        BetaOutcome = "beta.outcome",
        BetaExposure = "beta.exposure",
        SdOutcome = "se.outcome",
        SdExposure = "se.exposure",
        OUTLIERtest = TRUE,
        DISTORTIONtest = TRUE,
        data = x,
        NbDistribution = nb_distribution_used,
        SignifThreshold = significance_threshold,
        seed = as.integer(seed + i)
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    
    
    # Record an error for one protein without stopping all proteins.
    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
        direction = direction_label,
        exposure = exposure_name,
        outcome = outcome_name,
        id.exposure = exposure_id,
        id.outcome = outcome_id,
        nsnp = number_of_snps,
        nb_distribution = nb_distribution_used,
        global_RSSobs = NA_real_,
        global_p_reported = NA_character_,
        global_p = NA_real_,
        raw_beta = NA_real_,
        raw_se = NA_real_,
        raw_p = NA_real_,
        corrected_beta = NA_real_,
        corrected_se = NA_real_,
        corrected_p = NA_real_,
        distortion_coefficient = NA_real_,
        distortion_p_reported = NA_character_,
        distortion_p = NA_real_,
        number_of_outliers = NA_integer_,
        outlier_SNPs = NA_character_,
        status = paste("MR-PRESSO error:", conditionMessage(fit))
      )
      
      outlier_results[[i]] <- empty_outlier_table()
      next
    }
    
    raw_results[[i]] <- fit
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract raw and outlier-corrected MR estimates
    # IMPORTANT: keep [[...]] together on one line.
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    main_results_object <- fit[["Main MR results"]]
    
    if (is.null(main_results_object)) {
      main_results <- data.frame()
    } else {
      main_results <- as.data.frame(
        main_results_object,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    if (
      nrow(main_results) > 0L &&
      "MR Analysis" %in% names(main_results)
    ) {
      raw_estimate <- main_results[
        main_results[["MR Analysis"]] == "Raw",
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      corrected_estimate <- main_results[
        main_results[["MR Analysis"]] == "Outlier-corrected",
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    } else {
      raw_estimate <- data.frame()
      corrected_estimate <- data.frame()
    }
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract global pleiotropy test
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    presso_results <- fit[["MR-PRESSO results"]]
    
    if (is.null(presso_results)) {
      presso_results <- list()
    }
    
    global_test <- presso_results[["Global Test"]]
    global_rss <- extract_named_numeric(global_test, "RSSobs")
    global_p_reported <- extract_named_character(global_test, "Pvalue")
    
    parsed_global_p <- parse_presso_pvalue(global_p_reported)
    global_p <- if (length(parsed_global_p) == 0L) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      parsed_global_p[1]
    }
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract SNP-specific outlier test
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    outlier_test <- presso_results[["Outlier Test"]]
    significant_outlier_snps <- character(0)
    outlier_table <- empty_outlier_table()
    
    if (!is.null(outlier_test)) {
      outlier_test_df <- as.data.frame(
        outlier_test,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
      
      if (
        nrow(outlier_test_df) > 0L &&
        all(c("RSSobs", "Pvalue") %in% names(outlier_test_df))
      ) {
        outlier_table <- outlier_test_df %>%
          rownames_to_column("SNP") %>%
          transmute(
            direction = direction_label,
            exposure = exposure_name,
            outcome = outcome_name,
            id.exposure = exposure_id,
            id.outcome = outcome_id,
            SNP = as.character(SNP),
            RSSobs = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(RSSobs)),
            outlier_p_reported = as.character(Pvalue),
            outlier_p = parse_presso_pvalue(Pvalue),
            significant_outlier =
              !is.na(outlier_p) &
              outlier_p <= significance_threshold
          )
        
        significant_outlier_snps <- outlier_table %>%
          filter(significant_outlier %in% TRUE) %>%
          pull(SNP)
      }
    }
    
    outlier_results[[i]] <- outlier_table
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract distortion test
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    distortion_test <- presso_results[["Distortion Test"]]
    
    distortion_coefficient <- extract_named_numeric(
      distortion_test,
      "Distortion Coefficient"
    )
    
    distortion_p_reported <- extract_named_character(
      distortion_test,
      "Pvalue"
    )
    
    parsed_distortion_p <- parse_presso_pvalue(
      distortion_p_reported
    )
    
    distortion_p <- if (length(parsed_distortion_p) == 0L) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      parsed_distortion_p[1]
    }
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Create one summary row for this protein
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    number_of_outliers <- length(significant_outlier_snps)
    
    outlier_snp_string <- if (number_of_outliers > 0L) {
      paste(significant_outlier_snps, collapse = ";")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
    
    analysis_status <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(global_p) ~
        "Completed; global p-value unavailable",
      
      global_p >= significance_threshold ~
        "Global test not significant; no outlier correction required",
      
      number_of_outliers == 0L ~
        paste0(
          "Global test significant, but no individual outlier ",
          "passed the corrected threshold"
        ),
      
      TRUE ~
        "Outlier SNPs detected; corrected estimate available"
    )
    
    summary_results[[i]] <- tibble(
      direction = direction_label,
      exposure = exposure_name,
      outcome = outcome_name,
      id.exposure = exposure_id,
      id.outcome = outcome_id,
      nsnp = number_of_snps,
      nb_distribution = nb_distribution_used,
      global_RSSobs = global_rss,
      global_p_reported = global_p_reported,
      global_p = global_p,
      raw_beta = extract_table_numeric(raw_estimate, "Causal Estimate"),
      raw_se = extract_table_numeric(raw_estimate, "Sd"),
      raw_p = extract_table_numeric(raw_estimate, "P-value"),
      corrected_beta = extract_table_numeric(
        corrected_estimate,
        "Causal Estimate"
      ),
      corrected_se = extract_table_numeric(corrected_estimate, "Sd"),
      corrected_p = extract_table_numeric(corrected_estimate, "P-value"),
      distortion_coefficient = distortion_coefficient,
      distortion_p_reported = distortion_p_reported,
      distortion_p = distortion_p,
      number_of_outliers = number_of_outliers,
      outlier_SNPs = outlier_snp_string,
      status = analysis_status
    )
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine all protein analyses for one eGFR measure
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  summary_table <- bind_rows(summary_results) %>%
    mutate(
      global_p_FDR_direction = p.adjust(global_p, method = "fdr"),
      raw_p_FDR_direction = p.adjust(raw_p, method = "fdr"),
      corrected_p_FDR_direction = p.adjust(corrected_p, method = "fdr")
    )
  
  outlier_table <- bind_rows(outlier_results)
  
  analysis_names <- vapply(
    analysis_groups,
    function(group_data) {
      paste(
        as.character(group_data$exposure[1]),
        as.character(group_data$outcome[1]),
        sep = "__"
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )
  
  names(raw_results) <- make.unique(analysis_names)
  
  list(
    summary = summary_table,
    outliers = outlier_table,
    raw_results = raw_results
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 4. Confirm that harmonised datasets exist
# ============================================================

if (!exists("dat_reverse_creat")) {
  stop(
    "Object 'dat_reverse_creat' was not found. ",
    "Run the eGFRcrea harmonisation step first."
  )
}

if (!exists("dat_reverse_cys")) {
  stop(
    "Object 'dat_reverse_cys' was not found. ",
    "Run the eGFRcys harmonisation step first."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. Run MR-PRESSO
# ============================================================

set.seed(1234)

presso_reverse_creat <- run_mrpresso_by_outcome(
  harmonised_data = dat_reverse_creat,
  direction_label = "eGFRcrea->Protein",
  nb_distribution = 10000L,
  significance_threshold = 0.05,
  seed = 1234L
)

presso_reverse_cys <- run_mrpresso_by_outcome(
  harmonised_data = dat_reverse_cys,
  direction_label = "eGFRcys->Protein",
  nb_distribution = 10000L,
  significance_threshold = 0.05,
  seed = 5678L
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Combine results from both eGFR measures
# ============================================================

presso_summary_all <- bind_rows(
  presso_reverse_creat$summary,
  presso_reverse_cys$summary
) %>%
  mutate(
    global_p_FDR_all = p.adjust(global_p, method = "fdr"),
    raw_p_FDR_all = p.adjust(raw_p, method = "fdr"),
    corrected_p_FDR_all = p.adjust(corrected_p, method = "fdr")
  )

presso_outliers_all <- bind_rows(
  presso_reverse_creat$outliers,
  presso_reverse_cys$outliers
)


# ============================================================
# 7. Display results
# ============================================================

cat("\n========== MR-PRESSO SUMMARY ==========\n")

print(
  presso_summary_all %>%
    select(
      direction,
      outcome,
      nsnp,
      nb_distribution,
      global_RSSobs,
      global_p_reported,
      global_p,
      global_p_FDR_direction,
      global_p_FDR_all,
      number_of_outliers,
      raw_beta,
      raw_se,
      raw_p,
      corrected_beta,
      corrected_se,
      corrected_p,
      distortion_coefficient,
      distortion_p_reported,
      distortion_p,
      outlier_SNPs,
      status
    )
)

cat("\n=== Nominally significant MR-PRESSO global tests ===\n")
print(
  presso_summary_all %>%
    filter(!is.na(global_p), global_p < 0.05)
)

cat("\n=== FDR-significant MR-PRESSO global tests ===\n")
print(
  presso_summary_all %>%
    filter(!is.na(global_p_FDR_all), global_p_FDR_all < 0.05)
)

cat("\n=== Significant MR-PRESSO outlier SNPs ===\n")

significant_outliers_all <- presso_outliers_all %>%
  filter(significant_outlier %in% TRUE)

if (nrow(significant_outliers_all) > 0L) {
  print(significant_outliers_all)
} else {
  cat("No significant MR-PRESSO outlier SNPs were identified.\n")
}


# ============================================================
# 8. Save results
# ============================================================

output_directory <- "MR_results_reverse/MR_PRESSO"

dir.create(
  output_directory,

write.csv(

write.csv(

write.csv(
```

#successful code for plotting 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Clean and robust reverse MR plotting code
# Save plots to: results/MR_plots_reverse
# ============================================================

library(TwoSampleMR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Close any open graphics devices
while (dev.cur() > 1) {
  dev.off()
}

# Absolute output directory
plots_dir_reverse <- file.path(mr_results_dir, "MR_plots_reverse")

if (!dir.exists(plots_dir_reverse)) {
  dir.create(plots_dir_reverse, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

cat("Reverse MR plots will be saved here:\n")
cat(normalizePath(plots_dir_reverse, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")

# Check write permission
test_file <- file.path(plots_dir_reverse, "test_write_permission.txt")

if (file.create(test_file)) {
  file.remove(test_file)
  cat("✓ Write permission confirmed\n")
} else {
  stop("No write permission in: ", plots_dir_reverse)
}


# ============================================================
# Helper: convert TwoSampleMR plot output to list
# ============================================================

as_plot_list <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(list())
  }
  
  if (inherits(x, "ggplot")) {
    return(list(x))
  }
  
  if (is.list(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  
  return(list(x))
}


# ============================================================
# Helper: save plot list safely as PDFs
# ============================================================

save_plot_list_pdf <- function(plot_object,
                               file_prefix,
                               pdf_dir,
                               width = 12,
                               height = 10) {
  
  plot_list <- as_plot_list(plot_object)
  
  if (length(plot_list) == 0) {
    cat("No plots to save for:", file_prefix, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  for (i in seq_along(plot_list)) {
    
    pdf_file <- file.path(
      pdf_dir,
      paste0(file_prefix, "_", i, ".pdf")
    )
    
    grDevices::pdf(
      file = pdf_file,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      useDingbats = FALSE
    )
    
    tryCatch(
      {
        print(plot_list[[i]])
      },
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Could not save:", basename(pdf_file), "\n")
        cat("Error:", e$message, "\n")
      },
      finally = {
        grDevices::dev.off()
      }
    )
    
    cat("Saved:", pdf_file, "\n")
  }
}


# ============================================================
# Main reverse MR plotting function
# ============================================================

plot_reverse_mr_results_simple <- function(results,
                                           outcome_label,
                                           pdf_dir = plots_dir_reverse,
                                           width = 12,
                                           height = 10) {
  
  if (is.null(results)) {
    cat("Results object is NULL for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.null(results$mr_results) || nrow(results$mr_results) == 0) {
    cat("No MR results found for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (is.null(results$harmonised_data) || nrow(results$harmonised_data) == 0) {
    cat("No harmonised data found for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Generating reverse MR plots for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  cat("Saving to:", pdf_dir, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Single-SNP results
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  single_snp <- tryCatch(
    mr_singlesnp(results$harmonised_data),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("mr_singlesnp failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(single_snp) || nrow(single_snp) == 0) {
    cat("No single-SNP results available for:", outcome_label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Forest plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  forest_plot <- tryCatch(
    mr_forest_plot(single_snp),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Forest plot failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  save_plot_list_pdf(
    forest_plot,
    paste0("1_forest_plot_", outcome_label),
    pdf_dir,
    width,
    height
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Funnel plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  funnel_plot <- tryCatch(
    mr_funnel_plot(single_snp),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Funnel plot failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  save_plot_list_pdf(
    funnel_plot,
    paste0("2_funnel_plot_", outcome_label),
    pdf_dir,
    width,
    height
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Leave-one-out plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (!is.null(results$leaveoneout) && nrow(results$leaveoneout) > 0) {
    
    loo_plot <- tryCatch(
      mr_leaveoneout_plot(results$leaveoneout),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Leave-one-out plot failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    save_plot_list_pdf(
      loo_plot,
      paste0("3_leaveoneout_plot_", outcome_label),
      pdf_dir,
      width,
      height
    )
    
  } else {
    cat("Leave-one-out plot skipped for:", outcome_label, "\n")
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scatter plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  
  scatter_plot <- tryCatch(
    mr_scatter_plot(
      mr_results = results$mr_results,
      dat = results$harmonised_data
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Scatter plot failed for", outcome_label, ":", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  save_plot_list_pdf(
    scatter_plot,
    paste0("4_scatter_plot_", outcome_label),
    pdf_dir,
    width,
    height
  )
  
  cat("\nFinished reverse MR plots for:", outcome_label, "\n")
}


# ============================================================
# Run reverse MR plotting
# ============================================================

plot_reverse_mr_results_simple(
  results = reverse_creat,
  outcome_label = "reverse_eGFRcrea_to_protein",
  pdf_dir = plots_dir_reverse
)

plot_reverse_mr_results_simple(
  results = reverse_cys,
  outcome_label = "reverse_eGFRcys_to_protein",
  pdf_dir = plots_dir_reverse
)


# ============================================================
# Check saved files
# ============================================================

cat("\nAll reverse MR plots saved here:\n")
cat(normalizePath(plots_dir_reverse, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")

cat("\nSaved PDF files:\n")
print(
  list.files(
    plots_dir_reverse,
    pattern = "\\.pdf$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# MENDELIAN RANDOMIZATION FOREST PLOTS
#
# File:
#   MR_Results.xlsx
#
# Analyses:
#   1. Forward MR: Protein -> kidney function
#   2. Reverse MR: Kidney function -> protein
#
# Methods:
#   IVW
#   Weighted median
#   MR-Egger
#
# Output:
#   PNG + PDF forest plots
#   Cleaned CSV files used for plotting
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 0. SET WORKING DIRECTORY
# ============================================================

setwd(
  mr_forest_dir
)


# Check working directory
getwd()


# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD PACKAGES
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)


# ============================================================
# 2. FILE PATH
# ============================================================

file_path <-
  mr_workbook


# ============================================================
# 3. CHECK EXCEL SHEETS
# ============================================================

sheet_names <-
  excel_sheets(
    file_path
  )

print(
  sheet_names
)


# ============================================================
# 4. FOREST-PLOT SETTINGS
# ============================================================

MR_colors <-
  c(
    "IVW" =
      "#F8766D",

    "Weighted median" =
      "#00BFC4",

    "MR-Egger" =
      "#7CAE00"
  )


# Proteins in your MR results
protein_order <-
  c(
    "AZGP1",
    "B2M",
    "CFD",
    "LRRTM2",
    "PTGDS",
    "RBP4",
    "SERPINF1",
    "TFRC"
  )


# Position adjustment so the 3 MR methods
# appear separately for each protein
dodge <-
  position_dodge(
    width = 0.55
  )


# ============================================================
# PART I
# FORWARD-DIRECTION MENDELIAN RANDOMIZATION
#
# Protein -> kidney function
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 5. READ FORWARD MR TABLE
# ============================================================

forward_results <-
  read_excel(

    path =
      file_path,

    sheet =
      "Forward Direction",

    skip =
      4,

    col_names =
      c(
        "Outcome",
        "Protein",
        "Method",
        "No_IVs",
        "Beta",
        "SE",
        "FDR_p",
        "Q_statistic",
        "Q_p",
        "Egger_intercept",
        "Egger_p",
        "Exposure_database",
        "Outcome_database"
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. CHECK RAW FORWARD TABLE
# ============================================================

head(
  forward_results
)

str(
  forward_results
)

names(
  forward_results
)


# ============================================================
# 7. CLEAN FORWARD RESULTS
# ============================================================

forward_results <-
  forward_results %>%

  # Fill repeated merged-cell information downward
  tidyr::fill(
    Outcome,
    Protein,
    .direction = "down"
  ) %>%

  # Keep actual MR result rows
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Method),
    !is.na(Beta),
    !is.na(SE)
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Simplify kidney-function outcome names
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Outcome =
      dplyr::case_when(

        stringr::str_detect(
          Outcome,
          "eGFRcrea"
        ) ~
          "eGFRcrea",

        stringr::str_detect(
          Outcome,
          "eGFRcys"
        ) ~
          "eGFRcys",

        TRUE ~
          as.character(Outcome)
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Convert numerical variables
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Beta =
      as.numeric(Beta),

    SE =
      as.numeric(SE),

    FDR_p =
      as.numeric(FDR_p),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lower_CI =
      Beta -
      1.96 * SE,

    upper_CI =
      Beta +
      1.96 * SE,


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Simplify MR method names
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Method =
      dplyr::recode(

        as.character(Method),

        "Inverse variance weighted" =
          "IVW",

        "Weighted median" =
          "Weighted median",

        "MR-Egger" =
          "MR-Egger"
      ),


    Method =
      factor(
        Method,
        levels =
          c(
            "IVW",
            "Weighted median",
            "MR-Egger"
          )
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Order proteins in the figure
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Protein =
      factor(
        Protein,
        levels =
          rev(
            protein_order
          )
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. CHECK CLEANED FORWARD RESULTS
# ============================================================

print(
  forward_results
)


# ============================================================
# 9. SAVE CLEANED FORWARD RESULTS
# ============================================================

write.csv(

  forward_results,

  file =
    "Forward_MR_forest_data.csv",

  row.names =
    FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 10. FORWARD MR FOREST PLOT
# ============================================================

forest_forward <-
  ggplot(

    forward_results,

    aes(

      x =
        Beta,

      y =
        Protein,

      color =
        Method,

      group =
        Method
    )
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Null-effect line
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_vline(

    xintercept =
      0,

    linetype =
      "dashed",

    linewidth =
      0.8,

    color =
      "grey40"
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 95% confidence intervals
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_errorbar(

    aes(

      xmin =
        lower_CI,

      xmax =
        upper_CI
    ),

    orientation =
      "y",

    width =
      0.10,

    linewidth =
      0.8,

    position =
      dodge
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Beta estimates
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point(

    size =
      3.2,

    position =
      dodge
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Separate eGFR outcomes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  facet_wrap(

    ~ Outcome,

    ncol =
      2,

    scales =
      "free_x"
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Colors
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_color_manual(

    values =
      MR_colors,

    drop =
      FALSE
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  labs(

    title =
      "Forward Mendelian randomization",

    subtitle =
      "Protein → kidney function",

    x =
      expression(
        beta ~ "(95% CI)"
      ),

    y =
      NULL,

    color =
      "MR method"
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Theme
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  theme_minimal(
    base_size =
      14
  ) +

  theme(

    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.x =
      element_line(
        color =
          "grey92"
      ),

    panel.grid.major.y =
      element_line(
        color =
          "grey90"
      ),

    legend.position =
      "bottom",

    legend.title =
      element_text(
        size =
          11
      ),

    legend.text =
      element_text(
        size =
          10
      ),

    plot.title =
      element_text(

        face =
          "bold",

        size =
          16
      ),

    plot.subtitle =
      element_text(
        size =
          12
      ),

    strip.text =
      element_text(

        face =
          "bold",

        size =
          13
      ),

    axis.text.y =
      element_text(
        size =
          11
      ),

    axis.text.x =
      element_text(
        size =
          10
      )
  )
```

#calculate the F stat 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# F-STATISTICS FOR FORWARD AND REVERSE MR
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)


# ============================================================
# 1. SET WORKING DIRECTORY
# ============================================================

setwd(
  mr_results_dir
)


# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD HARMONIZED DATASETS
# ============================================================

# Forward MR
load("dat_egfr_creat_harmonised.RData")
load("dat_egfr_cys_harmonised.RData")

# Reverse MR
load("dat_reverse_creat.RData")
load("dat_reverse_cys.RData")


# ============================================================
# 3. CHECK EXPOSURE AND OUTCOME
# ============================================================

cat("\nFORWARD eGFRcrea\n")
print(unique(dat_egfr_creat$exposure))
print(unique(dat_egfr_creat$outcome))

cat("\nFORWARD eGFRcys\n")
print(unique(dat_egfr_cys$exposure))
print(unique(dat_egfr_cys$outcome))

cat("\nREVERSE eGFRcrea\n")
print(unique(dat_reverse_creat$exposure))
print(unique(dat_reverse_creat$outcome))

cat("\nREVERSE eGFRcys\n")
print(unique(dat_reverse_cys$exposure))
print(unique(dat_reverse_cys$outcome))


# ============================================================
# 4. FUNCTION TO CALCULATE F-STATISTICS
#
# F = (beta.exposure / se.exposure)^2
# ============================================================

calculate_F <- function(data, direction, kidney_measure) {

  # SNP-specific F-statistics
  snp_results <- data %>%

    mutate(

      F_statistic =
        (beta.exposure / se.exposure)^2

    ) %>%

    # Remove duplicated exposure-SNP combinations
    distinct(
      exposure,
      SNP,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )


  # Summary by exposure
  summary_results <- snp_results %>%

    group_by(
      exposure
    ) %>%

    summarise(

      N_IVs =
        n(),

      Mean_F =
        mean(
          F_statistic,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Median_F =
        median(
          F_statistic,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Min_F =
        min(
          F_statistic,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Max_F =
        max(
          F_statistic,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      N_F_below_10 =
        sum(
          F_statistic < 10,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Percent_F_below_10 =
        100 *
        mean(
          F_statistic < 10,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%

    mutate(

      Direction =
        direction,

      Kidney_measure =
        kidney_measure,

      .before =
        exposure
    ) %>%

    mutate(

      across(
        c(
          Mean_F,
          Median_F,
          Min_F,
          Max_F,
          Percent_F_below_10
        ),
        ~ round(.x, 2)
      )
    )


  return(
    list(
      SNP_results = snp_results,
      Summary = summary_results
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. FORWARD MR
#
# Protein -> eGFR
# ============================================================

F_forward_creat <-
  calculate_F(
    data = dat_egfr_creat,
    direction = "Forward",
    kidney_measure = "eGFRcrea"
  )


F_forward_cys <-
  calculate_F(
    data = dat_egfr_cys,
    direction = "Forward",
    kidney_measure = "eGFRcys"
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. REVERSE MR
#
# eGFR -> Protein
# ============================================================

F_reverse_creat <-
  calculate_F(
    data = dat_reverse_creat,
    direction = "Reverse",
    kidney_measure = "eGFRcrea"
  )


F_reverse_cys <-
  calculate_F(
    data = dat_reverse_cys,
    direction = "Reverse",
    kidney_measure = "eGFRcys"
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. COMBINE ALL SUMMARY RESULTS
# ============================================================

F_summary_all <-
  bind_rows(

    F_forward_creat$Summary,

    F_forward_cys$Summary,

    F_reverse_creat$Summary,

    F_reverse_cys$Summary
  )


# View
print(
  F_summary_all,
  n = Inf
)


# ============================================================
# 8. COMBINE SNP-SPECIFIC RESULTS
# ============================================================

F_SNP_all <-
  bind_rows(

    F_forward_creat$SNP_results %>%
      mutate(
        Direction = "Forward",
        Kidney_measure = "eGFRcrea"
      ),

    F_forward_cys$SNP_results %>%
      mutate(
        Direction = "Forward",
        Kidney_measure = "eGFRcys"
      ),

    F_reverse_creat$SNP_results %>%
      mutate(
        Direction = "Reverse",
        Kidney_measure = "eGFRcrea"
      ),

    F_reverse_cys$SNP_results %>%
      mutate(
        Direction = "Reverse",
        Kidney_measure = "eGFRcys"
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 9. SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  F_summary_all,
  "MR_F_statistics_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  F_SNP_all,
  "MR_F_statistics_SNP_specific.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 10. CHECK WHETHER ANY WEAK INSTRUMENTS EXIST
# ============================================================

F_summary_all %>%
  select(
    Direction,
    Kidney_measure,
    exposure,
    N_IVs,
    Mean_F,
    Min_F,
    N_F_below_10,
    Percent_F_below_10
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ============================================================
# 11. SAVE F-STATISTIC OBJECTS AS RDATA
# ============================================================

save(
  F_forward_creat,
  file = "F_forward_creat.RData"
)

save(
  F_forward_cys,
  file = "F_forward_cys.RData"
)

save(
  F_reverse_creat,
  file = "F_reverse_creat.RData"
)

save(
  F_reverse_cys,
  file = "F_reverse_cys.RData"
)


# ============================================================
# 12. SAVE COMBINED F-STATISTIC RESULTS
# ============================================================

save(
  F_summary_all,
  F_SNP_all,
  file = "MR_F_statistics_all.RData"
)


# ============================================================
# 13. SAVE SUMMARY AND SNP-SPECIFIC TABLES AS CSV
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  F_summary_all,
  "MR_F_statistics_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  F_SNP_all,
  "MR_F_statistics_SNP_specific.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 14. CONFIRM SAVED FILES
# ============================================================

cat(
  "\nF-statistic results saved in:\n",
  getwd(),
  "\n"
)
```
